The group photo taken after March 7th won the Best Newcomer Award at the photography exhibition, with friends that helped during the exhibition specially invited to appear.

"The journey freezes into moments, moments weave into memories, and memories tell a story... The trailblazing expedition continues, and the story will not end here."

140518.lore:
A camera lens gifted by Sparkle. To this day, you still are unsure of its exact use.

"Transient and never repeating. Is capturing the vibrant scenes within the kaleidoscope merely a futile wishful thinking?"

140519.lore: This memory of Castrum Kremnos comes from a bard, who praises the never-ending glory of the Strife Titan.

140520.lore: This memory of Castrum Kremnos originates from the Grand Craftsman Chartonus, seemingly carrying with it the profound and weighty history of the Mountain Dwellers.

140521.lore: This memory of Castrum Kremnos stems from an adventurer named Damionis, showcasing the golden era of the city's grandeur.

140522.lore:
A dream bubble gifted by Tingyun, which records your journeys on the Xianzhou. In this dream, the real Tingyun never missed out on meeting you.

"The future is neither an initial meeting nor a reunion — We have always walked together."

140523.lore: The cheapest food available — some of it already spoiled — but for the starving, there's no room for choice.

140524.lore: Fresh food with simple, balanced nutrition. Commoners might tolerate it for a few meals, but for those on the brink of starvation, it tastes as sweet as honey.

140525.lore: Exquisitely refined dishes, each a delicate masterpiece. An ordinary family may savor them for a week, while the starving would be swept straight to heaven with each bite.

140526.lore:
A trophy obtained after completing a mysterious challenge. If you listen carefully, you will hear some mournful mutters reverberating within the hollow skull.

"This is what paradise is like: Those who know that it is a paradise cannot return. Those who do not know it is a paradise seek wonderland within its expanse."

140527.lore:
A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140528.lore:
A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140529.lore:
A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140530.lore:
A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140531.lore: Strange crystals that store the power of Remembrance appear as you journey along. The light and shadows cast by the crystals seem to play out familiar scenes, and if you place them close to your ear, you can even hear the familiar whispers...

140532.lore:
Strange aquatic flowers, their sheen dazzling and warm.
It is said that they are tokens of the eternal vows between two revered deities.

140533.lore:
Strange aquatic flowers, their amber-colored soft flames sway imperceptibly.
It is said that they are tokens of the eternal vows between two revered deities, and now it holds the soul of one of them.

140534.lore: A Steelclaw Dagger, a type of weapon unique to Castrum Kremnos. Its grip shows signs of wear, with the patterns faded, giving it the look of an old blade.

140535.lore: The Kremnos Shield, a type of weapon unique to Castrum Kremnos. It just has a slightly dull coloration, giving it an aged appearance.

140536.lore: A Kremnos Greatsword, a type of weapon unique to Castrum Kremnos. Its blade appears to be fractured, as though it has been reforged.

140537.lore:
A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140538.lore:
A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

140539.lore:
An ancient-looking torch, said to hold the last unextinguished cinders of Georios. When the long night descends, it might bring a glimmer of light to a world in darkness.

"Heh, if you're afraid of the dark, just keep me by your side."

140540.lore:
A camera entrusted to you by your dear companion, March 7th. Taking her alias into account... Perhaps this camera is actually March 7th's true form. 

"Remember to take more photographs. I'll check on you!"

140541.lore:
A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.

"Who knows what this might summon..."

140542.lore:
A painting from the Rosy Celestial Maiden series, released by an opportunistic art dealer. You can't help but chuckle upon seeing March 7th's dashing form as she fights in this painting.

"Street stall art can never go out of style."

140543.lore: An old photograph of the Kremnos Festival, taken by Damionis. Though slightly blurred, it still faintly captures the grand scale of the festival.

140544.lore: Exceptionally pure redsoil feed, crafted with the ideal wet-to-dry ratio. It's the absolute favorite treat of dromases.

140545.lore: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It's somewhat clotted.

140546.lore: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It looks slightly dried up.

140547.lore: An essential sacrificial item for a mysterious ritual. It smells a little sour.

140548.lore:
A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.

"Who knows what this might summon..."

140549.lore:
A tattered scroll detailing the steps of an ancient, mysterious ritual, with annotations from an unknown person.

"Who knows what this might summon..."

140550.lore: A mysterious gift hidden behind the door, looking very valuable. What could it be?

140551.lore: A mysterious gift hidden behind the door, looking somewhat plain in appearance. What could it be?

140552.lore: A slate that is hidden by Possephone within the cushion. Its contents appear to reveal why Hadez acted against her.

140553.lore: A teleslate belonging to Possephone. From the memory you observed, it seems there was a glimmer of hope that Possephone could have escaped from Hadez.

140554.lore: A tattered and torn scroll. Based on the memory you observed, it is a replica of the one Rhadaman used to trap the married couple.

140556.lore: A stone seal that symbolizes one's identity as a priest of Janus. It can resound with and open the Gate of Infinity.

140557.desc: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
140557.lore:
A photo slate Apophis took of you after winning the Seal Slammers championship. The contestants were specially invited to appear in the photo, and the champion takes center stage.

"Dan Heng, let me wear the seal sunglasses for a while~"
"...You already have a trophy."

140558.desc: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
140558.lore:
A photo slate Apophis took of you after winning the Seal Slammers championship. The contestants were specially invited to appear in the photo, and the champion takes center stage.

"Dan Heng, let me wear the seal sunglasses for a while~"
"...You already have a trophy."

140559.lore: A bloodied Grove of Epiphany work permit with the name "Nicomachus."

140560.lore: A damaged Grove of Epiphany work permit with the name "Andreas."

140561.lore: A Grove of Epiphany work permit wrinkled with sweat with the name "Clio."

140562.lore:
A grain that is quite ordinary in realms beyond the sky but uncommon in Amphoreus.
The label on the specimen indicates it is the 330th generation of an experiment — perhaps the experiment has been ongoing for centuries.

"During the breeding process, the crop's resistance to the black tide has significantly improved. The next step will attempt to enable the crops to absorb energy from the black tide and survive in lightless environments, challenging the conventional belief that no life can endure within the black tide."

140563.lore:
A seemingly unremarkable scroll filled with various equations and symbols, so complex that even the Synesthesia Beacon struggles to provide a reliable translation.

"Self-reference is the most challenging problem — it not only strips mathematics of its completeness but also renders our souls enigmatic within the logical system."
"This equation should hold true. I have an excellent proof... but alas, the space here is too tiny for it."

140564.lore:
It is said that this somewhat hazardous-looking powder helps participants in Titan-worship ceremonies attune their consciousness to the thoughts of the Titans.

"So, what exactly is it made of?"
"An unrefined plant-based sugar."
"Huh? So eating it just means eating sugar?"
"Yes. The ceremonies are quite lengthy, and fasting participants often struggle to endure due to low blood sugar."
"..."

140565.lore: The sword once wielded by Artakama, a Chrysos Heir scholar of the Grove. In the dire battle against the black tide, this sword stood steadfast by its master until her final breath. Following Artakama's demise, her younger sister, Cynane, picked up the sword and continued the fight until the ceaseless swarms of monsters devoured everything living.

140566.lore:
A rare Amphorean fine wine. It is said to be brewed from crops nourished by the divine blood of each Titan.
This particular bottle originates from the Chrysalis of Gold, Mnestia of Romance.

140567.lore:
A golden spindle that belongs to "Goldweaver" Aglaea. A legendary treasure.

"Follow the golden thread, the love that contains all like the gods."

140568.lore:
A memorial medal issued by the Garden of Life to reward the sweat and tears shed by Chimera Squad that took the crown.

"To the most diligent chimera. We hope to see growth and improvement in your future work!"

140569.lore: The fallen soul of Oronyx the Time Titan. The Coreflame urgently awaits to return to its place, and its demigod will assume the authority of the vacant station after completing the trial.

140570.lore:
A handcrafted silver ring — if you hold it to your ear, you can hear the sound of melting snow.
In Aidonia, the departed seal ice and snow into a ring before their final journey, offering it to the living as a token to walk the rest of the path in their stead.

"When the ice melts and the snow fades, the flowers will bloom, and you will find me."

140571.lore:
A phantom thief's letter left behind by Kitty Phantom Thief, Cipher, out of "courtesy" and "honor."

"I fear it would attract tasteless little thieves, so I shall safeguard it for now."

140572.lore:
A coin left behind by Kitty Phantom Thief, Cipher, out of "courtesy" and "honor."

"Naturally, I've left appropriate payment — a single coin."

140573.lore:
Trianne secretly prepared a small gift for Castorice — a childlike drawing of the companions on their Flame-Chase Journey.
Castorice perceptively noticed that it, and the memory it represents, would be the key to saving {NICKNAME} from the nether realm.

"But Little Cas no longer has anything to fear now, because everyone is here with you in this Flame-Chase Journey!"

140574.lore: The fallen soul of Thanatos the Death Titan. The Coreflame urgently awaits to return to its place. The demigod of Death has already overcome the trial and assumed the authority of the Titan.

140575.lore:
The memory entity you carried away from a dream, in some foreign land, an artisan who admired the King and carved a puppet with heartfelt reverence. Though it seems far removed from the real King, and the craftsmanship leaves much to be desired, what heroes pass down to later generations is often just like this — crude, yet enough to soothe the soul.

"Besides, don't you think that, after staring at it for a while, it actually kind of feels full of soul?"
"I think it's trying to suck my soul in!"

140576.lore:
An old, tattered photograph captures the past of Miss Note — the cries of injustice behind bars, the jubilant song upon breaking free, the thunderous applause beneath the stage, the scorn born of disgrace. All those voices have faded into history, leaving only a yellowed memory behind.

"And even so, I still choose to sing."

140577.lore:
A Curio and Space Anchor from the world of Erudition that protects your individual data structure from the influences of digital tsunamis.
When necessary, it can also serve as a bridge for communications between the internal and external world.

140578.lore: It was a distant wish, and also her blessing.

140579.lore:
Rich, intense, sweet.

Not exactly sweet, but the contrast is obvious.

140580.lore: The bottle contains the heroic souls of pomegranates who fought to their last breath. Drink it, and honor their journey.

140581.lore: You can taste all the Amphorean fruits in this! Zero intoxication level, totally safe and worry-free!

140582.lore: Don't worry. It just looks like water from the River of Souls... probably.

140583.lore: Thoughts flowed like a fountain. By the time the pen stopped, only half a bottle of honey brew remained.

140584.lore: Harvesting grape clouds at the intersection of Evernight for extraction and bottling... mysterious purple-tinted... plain drinking water.

140585.lore: The kitty doesn't want to think about why this bottle of ambrosia has an exclamation mark in its name, and honestly, she has no clue either.

140586.lore: The taste hits you like a punch to the face. Might be just what you need for healing wounds.

140587.lore: Tides rise and fall, but the sound of waves remains eternal.

140588.lore: Despite the oddly saccharine naming sense, the complimentary drinks in the Marmoreal Palace guest rooms taste just ordinarily sweet.

140589.lore: An identification badge of the Flame-Chase Army, bearing the Imperator's highest command. The wearer has unrestricted access throughout the city.

140590.lore:
An unassuming ceramic cup, plain in craftsmanship. At that wanton feast, its cold rim passed her honey brew to your lips, branding you with the sin of exile, yet bestowing a dream of clarity in return.

"The worth of a vessel lies in what it once held, and who once held it, just as blades earn legend by battle, and heroes are remembered through sacrifice."

140591.lore:
Phagousa was said to have buried twelve bottles of fine vintage beneath the seabed, hoping to savor them a thousand years later. But even as the black tide silenced the song of Chalice of Plenty, not a single drop had been uncorked.

This bottle, sweetest of the twelve vintages, was brought ashore by the last surviving sea siren. The divine power it holds can pierce through any fog.

140592.lore: The Worldbearing Titan, Kephale's fallen soul. Yet seemingly some foreign force has tampered with them, making their divinity different from the one in the past Cycle. The Coreflame awaits its rightful return, through which the final Deliverer shall forge a new Era Nova.

140593.lore: An identification badge of the Flame-Chase Army, bearing the Imperator's highest command. The wearer has unrestricted access throughout the city.

140594.lore:
An unassuming ceramic cup, plain in craftsmanship. At that wanton feast, its cold rim passed her honey brew to your lips, branding you with the sin of exile, yet bestowing a dream of clarity in return.

"The worth of a vessel lies in what it once held, and who once held it, just as blades earn legend by battle, and heroes are remembered through sacrifice."

140595.lore:
Phagousa was said to have buried twelve bottles of fine vintage beneath the seabed, hoping to savor them a thousand years later. But even as the black tide silenced the song of Chalice of Plenty, not a single drop had been uncorked.

This bottle, sweetest of the twelve vintages, was brought ashore by the last surviving sea siren. The divine power it holds can pierce through any fog.

140596.lore:
A Curio. A Space Anchor in a world of Erudition. It can protect individual data structures from the influences of digital tsunamis.
When necessary, it can also serve as a bridge for communications between the internal and external world.

140597.lore:
A photo taken at an unknown time, but the reality of its touch is undeniable. In the past, this scene truly came to pass, leaving behind a proof of its transpiration. Though few are aware, a young girl will smile when she recalls a beautiful dream she once had.

The dreamer is also the dream-maker. The dream-maker is also the dreamer.
Only by offering up one's past can the most beautiful dreams be woven.
People will not lose themselves within them, unwilling to awaken. In their beautiful dreams, they will regain the courage to face the future.
And then, walk toward tomorrow.

140598.lore:
You decide how memories are ultimately presented. When that beautiful dream ended, you immortalized Firefly in the way she longed for.

The dreamer is also the dream-maker. The dream-maker is also the dreamer.
Only by offering up one's past can the most beautiful dreams be woven.
People will not lose themselves within them, unwilling to awaken. In their beautiful dreams, they will regain the courage to face the future.
And then, walk toward tomorrow.

140599.lore: From the "Champion of Strife": Mydei's bestowal, symbolizing both his glory and restraint as a ruler and protector.

140600.lore: From the "Trickery's Traveler": Cipher's bestowal, symbolizing her playful yet sincere blessings and desires.

140601.lore: From the "Servant of the Afterlife": Castorice's bestowal, symbolizing the tenacity and peace she watches over on the other side.

140602.lore: From the "Holy Child of Passage": Tribios's bestowal, symbolizing her unwavering faith and empathy throughout her journey in a thousand bodies.

140603.lore: From the "Weaver of Romance": Aglaea's bestowal, symbolizing her unchanging selflessness and temperance beneath her aloof perfection.

140604.lore: From the "Healer of the Sky": Hyacine's bestowal, symbolizing her gentle devotion and indiscriminate love for all of humanity.

140605.lore: From the "Scholar of Reason": Anaxa's bestowal, symbolizing the enlightenment and critique he calmly left for future generations.

140606.lore: To save the world, one must shoulder the burden of heavy wishes. Only by leaving it behind, can you absolve the obsession.

140607.lore: To save the world, one must be accompanied by searing despair. Only by shattering it, can you absolve the obsession.

140608.lore:
It was the New Year of the old calendar. That year, times were tough. The foxes couldn't afford to throw their feasts, the frogs didn't dare to sing, the monkeys stopped discussing flight, and the white rabbits hadn't passed through in ages.

But then it arrived.

A black rabbit.

Unlike those rabbits who couldn't care less about the moon, this one led its companions and gave the little animals here a hand.

...Ah, I should say, gave them a paw.

140609.lore:
The black rabbit brought along many friends: some look human, while others look quite strange.

They aren't quite as level-headed as the black rabbit. Heated arguments are just part of their daily routine.

But when a foe appears, they immediately cast aside their differences and fight with total trust, following even the most questionable orders.

As they say, good people must stick together. Friends won't always see eye to eye, but they'll always help each other live a better life.

140610.lore:
The foxes' prophecy came to pass. The flames of destruction ignited in the borderlands, sweeping all the way to the center of the world.

Many of the black rabbit's friends were sacrificed on the battlefield.

The frogs and monkeys were overcome with guilt, and no one was willing to sing at night anymore.

...But the black rabbit reached out its hand once again.

It said: "Stand up. You are worthy of singing your hearts out."

140611.lore:
The Phantasmoon New Game trophy will be awarded to every hero who offered their Wishpower to protect the Blue Planet!

"A joyful ending like this is exactly what readers who celebrate life deserve!"

140613.lore:
When we were kids, we all had countless "dreams."

They didn't need to promise a hefty paycheck, nor were they bound by the cramped realities of life. They could be completely unreasonable, or entirely nonsensical... They were bold and fiery. They were the future we dared to proclaim to the world, hands planted firmly on our hips.

As time passed, we all more or less parted ways with those first "dreams." We realized we lacked the talent, discovered that the reality of those dreams wasn't all that great, or learned that the weight of everyday life keeps us from reaching the stars.

We might complain, we might harbor regrets, and we might grieve. But no one ever regrets having had a "dream" during those tender, beautiful days of childhood — a dream that forever encouraged them to set sail.

This is the true meaning of a dream. And this is exactly why we must always safeguard a child's right to dream.

"Open this picture book. Take a look at the future these children are so eager to leap into. May you find your younger self within these pages."

140615.lore: A fantasy action visual novel pretty famous in the Planarcadia fandom. The premise looks awfully similar to Fate/stay night, but for certain "grown-up reasons," it's absolutely, totally unrelated.

As time passed, we all more or less parted ways with those first "dreams." We realized we lacked the talent, discovered that the reality of those dreams wasn't all that great, or learned that the weight of everyday life keeps us from reaching the stars.

We might complain, we might harbor regrets, and we might grieve. But no one ever regrets having had a "dream" during those tender, beautiful days of childhood — a dream that forever encouraged them to set sail.

This is the true meaning of a dream. And this is exactly why we must always safeguard a child's right to dream.

"Open this picture book. Take a look at the future these children are so eager to leap into. May you find your younger self within these pages."

140630.lore:
Peace returned, and many years passed.

A few foxes still remembered the day the forest nearly fell to destruction, but the monkeys and frogs had long since come to take everything for granted.

The white rabbits remained nowhere to be found. The vows etched on the gravestones had blurred and faded in the acid rain.

The black rabbit once said that an ideal world should be one where the presence of good people is as thin as the air... One wonders if he foresaw that what could be as natural and imperceptible as air need not be kindness, but melancholy.

Malice always reeks. But nihility and beauty share the same absence: colorless, odorless, and utterly indistinguishable.

A unique creation from Penacony, this syrup serves as a non-addictive tranquilizer, offering an ineffable experience of serenity and delight for a certain duration.

"Its manufacturer claims this syrup has all the benefits of religion and alcohol without any of their drawbacks."

150011.lore:
When it comes to SoulGlad, classic means the best. Despite three attempts to modify the formula, the SoulGlad company was compelled to return to the original recipe due to complaints from dissatisfied customers each time.

"Our double-blind tests show that over 70% of customers failed to discern the difference between the new formula and the original one."

150012.lore:
"One day, we will have a real house." With a cup of coffee in her hand, your wife says. "It will have a yard where we can grow flowers, a hall where we can dance, a transparent attic where we can gaze at the stars — and ideally, a small dog to cuddle and fall asleep with. That would truly be the truly blissful life."
You smile in silence and propose a toast. The warm vapor swirls and ascends, gently caressing the ceiling before dissipating.

"A bright future exists only in dreams."

150013.lore:
The poker game continued, reaching the fourth round. The man could not stop himself from checking his hand — his confidence had long since wavered.
"A true gambler won't hesitate to call, even if the chances of winning are impossibly small..." The young man on the opposite side of the table snickered, pushing all his chips forward. "All in."

"Being content is a virtue for mortals, whereas hesitation is a fatal flaw for gamblers."

150014.lore:
This soda made of fermented white grapes tastes both sour and bitter. It serves as an exceptionally revitalizing remedy for summer heat, and consuming it often results in sneezing and a runny nose. According to those who have tasted it, it feels like a cold hand pressed against your neck.

"Pika... Ah-choo...!"

150015.lore:
"Insufficient active ingredient. Experiment failed."
The scholar, frustrated by his 106,001st failure, randomly poked at the terminal. Developing a new poison formula proved to be much more challenging than anticipated. If he couldn't produce results by tomorrow...
His mind was overwhelmed with worry, leading him to knock over the test tube rack on the table. The liquids from two unidentified containers mixed, releasing a pungent odor...

"The 106,002nd attempt. Result: Successful."

150035.lore: It seems that all it takes for this door to open is returning the statue to its original position...

150036.lore:
A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.

"They said that the Dreamscape Ticker isn't the same as Clockie at all, just a scrapped early Clockie prototype..."

150037.lore:
A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.

"Please... just leave me be, Clockie. I just don't know how to face you... because I'm just a failed product."

150038.lore:
A single part of a lost heart that has fallen into an existential crisis.

"I... I'll never be qualified to be the real you. Just give up, Clockie!"

150039.lore:
A group photo of all the members of Dreamjolt Hostelry given to you by Starlet.

"There is no doubt that you are an excellent drinksmith. Thank you for your efforts."

150040.lore:
What does the taste of a sweet dream resemble? This question lacks a definitive answer. Hence, Dreamy Cones were introduced with an initial offering of over twenty distinct flavors. However, as time passed, only three prominent flavors endured, each representing a popular scenario found in dreams.

"So, the three most popular scenarios are... memory loss, car crash, and terminal illness?"

150041.lore:
This burger earns its name from the crunchy disc-shaped flaky chip nestled between the buns, and only a few individuals can consume it in a dignified way. In certain taverns, devouring a Floatdisc Burger without using your hands has become somewhat of a legendary challenge.

"Why is it that some Halovians always find fault with its appearance?"

150042.lore:
Resembling a clock, this pizza is precisely divided into twelve equal-sized slices, making it the perfect food for parties.

"What is the meaning behind the unique shape of this food? Some believe it pays homage to a mysterious wealthy individual, while others see it as a reminder to cherish each passing moment."

150043.lore:
Strictly, the Potato Fries Sundae is not merely a food but a unique culinary experience that can only be realized within a dream world. In this realm, potato fries never go soft because of cooling down, and the ice cream never melts because of warming up. Cold and heat achieve perfect harmony here.

"Finally, no more upset stomachs."

150044.lore:
Legend has it that poor inhabitants of border planets would add wood chips to their bread to satiate their hunger. Over time, this practice evolved into a peculiar tradition among aristocrats, symbolizing a "reverence" for the humble past.
This product features a variety of botanical additives, closely resembling an oak branch in terms of both appearance and composition, and only the most ambitious and determined individuals can consume it.

"Politicians from the Oak Family take pride in eating it without flinching, for they believe it to be a formidable feat."

150047.lore: The personalized bird ID card just for you in the game Origami Bird Clash. It's said to be customized by the system based on your appearance.

150048.lore: General of the Xianzhou Zhuming and Yunli's grandfather. Yunli had intended to talk to her grandfather about Guyun today, but the sword was stolen.

150049.lore: The prime suspect of this incident. She swore to completely melt every one of the cursed swords forged by her father, including Guyun.

150050.lore: A Kalevalan envoy in charge of diplomatic affairs. He led a delegation to return the ancient sword, Guyun, to the Xianzhou. Though Yunli calls it a cursed sword, Paavo firmly believes Guyun to be the sword of a hero as told in the legends from his home.

150051.lore: An artisan from the Artisanship Commission and the craftsman responsible for repairing Guyun. He checked on how Guyun was stored after you reminded him to keep the sword safe. Guyun was yet to be stolen at that time.

150052.lore: The lock on the sword casket that Guyun was stored in. Given its intact lock, the thief either had the key to the casket or it was never locked to begin with.

150053.lore: A rose petal that was caught in the hinge mechanism. You can only think of one person who would leave behind this ostentatious trace wherever he goes.

150055.lore:
The jade abacus given to you by artillery system engineer Old Bai of the Skysplitter. It contains a program he wrote that enables the Skysplitter to fire twenty-one ceremonial cannons.

"You must fire the cannons. You absolutely must. You'll regret it if you don't!"

150056.lore:
A tablet inscribed with hymns and other writings, prophesying towards the end. It is said that within these fragments lies a secret so profound that it longs to be uncovered.

"Prophecies never carry their message in plain words." — Anonymous Priest

150060.lore:
The token of the Trickery Titan. Like the Titan's mythical form, the coin has two faces, one smiling, one crying, effortlessly flipping in the air. It was originally used by fraudsters as counterfeit coins to replace the Balance Coins. Fearing that such actions would invoke Talanton's punishment, they crafted it in the image of Zagreus, seeking the blessing of Trickery.
However, as time passed, these coins became more precious than the Balance Coins due to the difficulty of their creation, becoming a favorite collectible of nobles and artists — though this could also be one of Zagreus' tricks.

"Rolling coins turn into wheels, thieves conceal their forms, gamblers wager fortunes." — Ode of Trickery

150061.lore: A bunch of tiny Rainbow blossoms. In floriography, it means "the beauty of the ordinary."

150062.lore: A stalk of exquisite Marquise blossoms. It represents a status of prestige.

A tablet inscribed with hymns and other writings, prophesying towards the end. It is said that within these fragments lies a secret so profound that it longs to be uncovered.

"Prophecies never carry their message in plain words." — Anonymous Priest

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

150080.lore:
Feed this memory into the Recording Conch and listen closely — the voice may speak of nature's secrets or confide hidden thoughts.
This is a memory about the "Hearth."
"Steaming tea, knitted scarves, and a tale without end."

150081.lore:
Feed this memory into the Recording Conch and listen closely — the voice may speak of nature's secrets or confide hidden thoughts.
This is a memory of "Snow."
"You used up all the paint? What did you draw?"
"I think... just pure white."

150082.lore:
Feed this memory into the Recording Conch and listen closely — the voice may speak of nature's secrets or confide hidden thoughts.
This is a memory of "A Rainy Night."
"I stretched out my palm and pressed it against the glass."
"It brought a coolness to my skin... and something that kept stirring inside me."

150083.lore:
Feed this memory into the Recording Conch and listen closely — the voice may speak of nature's secrets or confide hidden thoughts.
This is a memory of "Thunder."
"I like thunderstorms."
"Huh? Weren't you scared of thunder? You always came running to my place..."
"Yeah. That's why I like them."

150085.lore:

150086.lore:
Obtained by solving the nymph prophecy puzzle for each Garmentmaker. Redeemable at An Eternal Page for unique keepsakes.
It is the treasure at the end of the adventure, and the benchmark of a legend's prologue, born from the brand-new structure born after the Era Nova.
Influenced by Amphorean sagas of heroes, it presents itself in the current space-time as a golden apple.

"To give civilizations to time, to give years their life."

150087.lore:
A scroll with prophecies inscribed. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.
"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

150088.lore:
A minute "variable" of the world, born from the brand-new structure born after the Era Nova.
Each time you gaze at it, memories surge like a tide — as if a fragment of Amphoreus's years lies sealed within.
It might help you in a time you've not yet reached.

"Is it the legend-writers who become heroes, or must one first become a hero to write legends?"

150089.lore:
A 4-star certification from the Memchelin Gourmet Committee represents the highest recognition for a restaurant. To date, only one restaurant in the Membrance Maze has earned this prestigious honor.

"Never forget, the purpose of cooking is to bring happiness to our diners."

150090.lore:
An award from the Memchelin Gourmet Committee is the ultimate proof of excellence that every restaurant dreams of.

"Target: Memchelin 4-star!"

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

150093.lore: The Cosmicon Collective's Professional Certification, which indicates that the holder is recognized as having professional-grade dice mastery. Once obtained, you can swap different Prismatic Dice for your cards.

150094.lore: It seems to be a work left behind by an unknown poet from ancient times, when poetry had not yet vanished from ancient Benzaitengoku.

150095.desc: Use from your Inventory to view the group photo.
150095.lore:
With the dust settled between "Cardway" and the "Mogura Gang," friends old and new got together to snap a photo.
Fun fact: Everyone in the picture is a Cosmicon Collective pro, except for...

"Except for Detective Passerby. He's clueless when it comes to cards."
"Hey, was that really necessary? I... ugh, never mind."

150097.lore: Page after page of dense legalese that'll put anyone to sleep just looking at it. Whatever, the money's already in hand, so nothing too crazy should pop up down the line... right? ...Right?

150098.lore:
From the Nameless who bridge the stars to the cute critters of The Fluffy and the heroes who saved the universe... they've gathered here for you, waving their glowsticks with hope and cheer.

"In this vast universe, there are always people rooting for you. Never forget that, no matter where you go."

150099.lore:
A slice of bread that's the perfect type, shape, size, and flavor to recreate that classic gag. Just pop it in your mouth and run through an intersection to trigger a dramatic encounter—it's practically a law of the universe.

"So that's your excuse for running into me!?"
"I said I was sorry, okay!?"

150100.lore:
The original prototype for the King Pom-Pom figure. In Fluffy Across the Blue, it's a powerhouse that puts most of the Nameless to shame. It comes with a full suite of cleaning, laundry, and sanitizing systems, making it more than a match for 99% of the universe's housework.

"Pom-Pom is actually starting to feel a little threatened!"

150101.lore:
A Furbobo Weekly badge featuring artwork personally drawn by a famous comic artist, commemorating the Furbobo Weekly pop-up shop's victory as champion of Seafeld City's commercial district.

"Aww, these teary-eyed little furbos are the cutest, don't you think?"

150102.lore: A proposal for taking down the big boss, Oroboros.

180001.lore:
Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. 
Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry.

"...Isn't it ice?"
"No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state."
"...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

180002.lore:
Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal.
Not particularly good, but is edible.

"Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

180004.lore:
Particles that form the flame.
Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it.
#7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence.

"Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

180005.lore:
A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean.
Very useful, very handy.

"I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

180006.lore:
Is it fog, rain, or wind?
You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid.

"The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..."
"The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

180007.lore:
Reproductive units unique to plants.
Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good.

"Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

180008.lore:
To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.

"It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

180009.lore:
The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere.

"The scholars who planted them hoped that people would never have to experience the feeling of hunger again."

180010.lore:
After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.

"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

180011.lore:
Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony.
They once belonged to broken hearts.

"In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

180012.lore:
Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.

"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

180013.lore:
A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. 

"If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!"
"...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

181001.lore:
Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions.
Without them, nothing can be made.

"With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day."
"Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

181002.lore:
Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory.
Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality.

"I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

181003.lore:
Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives.
Smooth as egg white and full of protein.

"Every grain costs sweat and blood."

181004.lore:
Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip.
Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around.

"The legend of the Phoenix spreads far throughout the entire universe..."

181005.lore:
Shattered ice fallen from the stars.
The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime.

"Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."

181006.lore:
An electric ball made from captured lightning.
If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball.

"A genius in the past wanted to use Eye of Lightning to search for aliens. For this, Nous cast their gaze upon her. Not sure which is the bigger win: Found aliens for real or got noticed by Nous?"

181007.lore:
The eye of the storm remains stagnant.
Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm.

"Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?"
"Trailblazing!"
"...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

181008.lore:
Ripples in the Sea of Quanta.
Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation.

"Time, there's so much time."
"All the time there is."

181009.lore:
A leaf of unknown origin.
It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract.
The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power.

"One leaf, one world."

181010.lore:
Resilient meteoric ironsand.
Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders.

"Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them."
"I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

181011.lore:
The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation.

"Pick one, they are all outdated models. But once installed, they will undoubtedly bring a soul-like essence to your machines."

181012.lore:
Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds.

"The value of 'tradition' lies in its ability to evolve and progress, rather than remaining stagnant."

181013.lore:
While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers.

"Plunderers of Tian Dong, to the Shackling Prison they will go."

181014.lore:
I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer.

"Anyway, I hope you enjoy yourself."

181015.lore:
In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible.
In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death.

"They say hunger is the best seasoning, but I just want to fill my stomach."

181016.lore:
No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times.

"It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

181017.lore:
A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. 

"For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

181018.lore:
Salt crystals unearthed from the depths of the rift valley, revered by the farmers who toil on the land. Many keep one of these crystals in their homes, treasuring it as the "bared spine marrow of Georios," a generous gift to the farmers. When reclaiming barren land, just a small sprinkling of this rock salt is enough to transform the barren soil into fertile ground, breathing life back into the earth. 

"Non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic fertilizer is the best!"

182001.lore:
Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction.
Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds.
Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash.

"Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

182002.lore:
Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance.
Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip.
Do not ask what it's made of.

"It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

182003.lore:
Small stone with the power of The Hunt.
As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction.
Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not.

"The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

182004.lore:
Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation.
When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard.
Please do not use together with Solid Water.

"I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature."
"I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

182005.lore:
A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility.
It may have been a coin that people use to buy things.
But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them.

"I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

182006.lore:
Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition.
Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature.
It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking.

"The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

182007.lore:
A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony.
It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination.
A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go.

"All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

182008.lore:
At the bottom of Lunarescent Depths, there is a diverse array of nearly a hundred coral species, among which dragon scale coral holds the greatest value. Within the coral skeleton of dragon scale coral, there is a rich concentration of Heavenly East compound. This compound serves as the finest antibiotic in the cosmos and possesses numerous other medicinal properties. Despite almost ten thousand years of efforts, humans have yet to learn how to industrially produce this compound.
In front of the entrance to the Fanghu's Alchemy Commission stands a statue of dragon scale coral. Underneath it, there is an inscription that reads:

"When you mistakenly believe you can control nature, always remember: Nature is the ultimate biochemist."

182009.lore:
As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations.
Don't let these distractions sway your judgment.

"Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

182010.lore:
Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models.

"It's just like organic beings bathing in water."

182011.lore:
A spindle entwined with silk threads. When the first discarded garment handcrafted by Aglaea accidentally found its way to the market, people were left in awe. What ingenious trimming! What flawless hidden seams! What masterful cutting! For a time, the entire Okhema fashion scene was swept into a frenzy of imitating Aglaea's artistry. The type of spindle she uses also became a must-have among garmentmakers, but the golden thread wound around it — exclusive to the demigod of Mnestia — cannot be replicated no matter what.

"O beautiful Mnestia, grant me but one-tenth of Lady Aglaea's talent! I am willing to do anything in exchange!"

183001.lore:
The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous.
For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere.

"Wow."

183002.lore:
Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change.
What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame.

"Sserkal's life was remarkable. She was smart, kindhearted, and above all, humble. She remained curious and inquisitive, asking her final question in the club on the last day of her life, the answer to which has not been found to this day."

183003.lore:
A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams.

"Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."

183004.lore:
To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen.

"Scammers try to predict the future themselves, but prophets resort to higher powers."

183005.lore:
I'm tired of writing. I'm done with it.

"This is what is called 'weariness.'"

183006.lore:
According to legend, this is the heart of a prominent Intellitron leader, containing the Ultimate Source Code, the essence of all inorganic life. Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life.

"It may also be the pathway for demons to return to the mortal world."

183007.lore:
Legend has it that Amphoreus once hosted a beauty pageant where several renowned beauties each plucked a fruit from the golden apple tree. Mnestia declared that the contestant who returned the following year with their golden apple still intact would be deemed the most beautiful.
When the year passed, none of the contestants succeeded in the trial — even the finest golden apples had rotted, just as even the most radiant faces inevitably fade with time. But in the third year, an ordinary-looking peasant girl returned, not with an apple, but with a new seedling. She explained that she had been deeply saddened by the golden apple's decay and had carefully gathered the seeds from the rotting fruit, planting them to nurture a new tree. Moved by her actions, Georios appeared and urged Mnestia to crown the peasant girl as the most beautiful contestant.
Mnestia, however, was reluctant, unable to see any beauty in the girl. At that moment, Georios called upon Oronyx to cover Mnestia's eyes with the veil of night. The instant Mnestia lost their sight, they perceived the brilliance of the peasant girl's heart and joyfully awarded her the title.

"Agy, doesn't this legend sound like your story?"
"Heh... a beautiful tale, indeed."

210001.desc:
A record that can be played on the Express' phonograph. It might be a chance acquisition or a gift from someone else. All sorts of memories surge up when the music plays — the smiles, encounters, touches, and the excitement of battle. Maybe that is why people still collect records even as society rapidly advances.
The current record contains the track "Dawn of Disaster."
210001.lore: After the disaster, very few people were willing to investigate whether it was an accidental calamity or a calculated plot.

21001.lore:
The dim light outlines the dust tracks,
As a young girl mumbles sweetly in her sleep.
A silent figure appears behind her.
"Well, well, well, you're cuter without those glasses — I knew it."
The guitarist stares at her sleeping face, muttering to herself:
"Good night, the genius girl that worries a lot."

21002.lore:
"So happy I got to see Pom-Pom in new clothes today! I like it~"
"Today's my birthday! I'm still as cute as ever."
"Today, I finally finally finally have a junior! Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?"

We click the shutter many times without thinking.
Do we do that to capture the happiness at that moment?
Or to capture ourselves at that moment?

21003.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21003.lore:
"Shouldn't we get off? It's our stop."
A chuckle came from above. His eyes moved, but he didn't look up.

"To be clear, March always says you're expressionless, but I don't agree."
"The train's data bank show traces of an update, but the results weren't saved."
"So... which entry were you having trouble with?"

He grasped his pen tighter as he looked at the bloody scene drawn in the notebook from memory.

"I see. It was the one about you..."

21004.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21004.lore:
An old photo lies on the far end of the table in the guardian's residence.
She would always subconsciously move her eyes away whenever she happened to see it.
The memories of the past had already become distant, but the dreams of today still linger.

21005.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21005.lore:
"Moles, moles,"
"Leaving our holes,"
"Smart moles fear naught foes,"
"Moles, moles,"
"Bite your toes!"

21006.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21006.lore:
In the beginning, it had the exact same pose as the previous portrait.
Looking at the face identical to hers, she was convinced that this was not her.

"Impossible. How can two portraits be exactly the same?"

She tweaked its joints, opened its eyes, and made its fingers softer.
She looked happy when all the changes were done.

"Completely different from yesterday. This is more like who I am today."

21007.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Abundance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21007.lore:
When the doctor found the wounded girl, she was clinging to a machine that had stopped working, with all sorts of parts filling her pocket.
She took the girl back to her clinic and treated the wounds.
Drops of sweat slowly rolled down the girl's cheek, but she remained silent and her hands didn't stop fiddling the machine.
To the doctor, the way the girl was attached to the machine was very much like how she was attached to her patients who needed help.
So the doctor did not try to comfort the girl nor did she nag her about being more careful; but rather, she sat down with her to give her a moment of peace.

21008.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21008.lore:
In reality, most prey don't realize when danger is encroaching.
This one's no exception.
The sniper's scope slowly centers on a man throwing banknotes stack after stack, who seems completely oblivious to his impending demise.
"So that's what greed looks like. That amount is equal to several of my contracts already... No wonder someone wants him dead."

As if these thoughts were broadcasted out loud, the man in the scope turns his head, looking straight into the eyes of the sniper. 
"I've been waiting for you. Would this much be enough for you to hear me out?"

21009.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21009.lore:
"Did you not hear me? Don't go there ever again! What could you possibly be learning from those commoners!"
"But I've never heard any of the stories they tell about Belobog before..."

She pulled her brother behind her, denying him the chance to talk back.
"You are both Landaus! One day, you'll face hard choices. Especially you, Serval."

She knew that her brother did nothing wrong, but she couldn't think of a rebuttal.
She went to bed angry after the argument, vowing to herself:
"I will be a grown-up one day. And when that day comes, I will make choices..."
"My own choices..."

21010.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21010.lore:
Looking rather skeptical, the girl thrust the small sword at her imaginary enemy in an attempt to convince herself that this thing was useful.
How can something so feeble compete with my two-handed sword? Do enemies even notice when they get stabbed?

The owner of the sword did not seem to care about its size.
After all, enemies are defeated by strategy, not swords.
It doesn't matter whether the sword is heavy or light, as long as you use the pointy end.

She had no idea what to expect when she first started out on this journey.
All she knew was that she could at long last be rid of the judgmental eyes and petty bickering of her family.
She felt she finally understood what the poet was trying to say.
"One day, we would grow wings and forget what it was like to walk."

The light in her eyes became the glittering stars.

21012.lore:
The boy would always make sure that his gloves and elbow guards were in good shape before leaving.
He treasured his gloves more than anything because they were tight enough to hide secrets.
With this layer of protection, no one could see the bandages on his hand and the wound beneath them.
He would be treated as if he was normal, and he would be greeted just like everyone else.

That was all he asked for.

21013.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21013.lore:
She stood on the stage, waving at her audience, encouraging them to make their voice heard.
Songs, shouts, or laments — anything that makes a sound.
Voice your thoughts, so others can come to help.

"Don't make your heart as cold as this concrete jungle."

— Make the world clamor.

21014.lore:
On a bustling street, he walks and walks. The sunlight closely follows his footsteps.
He makes a stop and picks up an umbrella to shade himself from the sun
...and from that prying gaze.

21015.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21015.lore:
The limelight cast on the boxing ring is bright, but no brighter than all those beads of sweat running down his back.

He has long been determined to use his two fists to protect those he cherishes the most.
After all, they are the ones who ignited his determination in the first place.
They are the ones who have always been there for him, be it inside or outside the boxing ring.

21016.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21016.lore:
The planet is receiving a revaluation...

"Will this project show that it's mutually beneficial to collect any outstanding debts?"
"But we only need to convey one message — our existence."

"If it were to have a value of its own, then it must create value for the corporation."

21017.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21017.lore:
"Yo, yo. What is up! Is everything coming through?"

The orange-haired girl slowly lifts a sledgehammer while shouting enthusiastically at the camera.
"Ever seen a pretty girl doing the cinder-block-smashed-on-chest stunt?"

"I didn't sign up for this!"
The brunette girl cried out loud, only to be met with a sly smile from the girl with the orange hair.
"Please. Just let me do this. This is what people would've wanted."

21018.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21018.lore:
"Why couldn't Hook do a spinning dance move, just like how Clara does?"
She clenched her tiny fists and pouted her cute lips, her chubby little face looking redder than ever under her signature felt hat.
"Please, Mr. Svarog, can you please help Hook with this?"
Without saying any words, Mr. Svarog began to hold out his robotic arm.

"I'm g—gonna be sick!!! Put me down now! Please!"

21019.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21019.lore:
Under the blue sky, fields of wheat were dancing.
The young girl was carefully weaving a flower wreath,
for her most beloved little sister.

That was when they were still the same height.
That was when they shared the same smile.

She pointed at that green rice cake.
"The experiment has ended. Time to take a break. I just can't miss this freshly made dessert."

She saw the puppet girl frowning in deep thought.
"Well, in your current body, you can only look but not eat. I'll make you a box of new ones when the time comes."

She saw the mechanical aristocrat hesitating at his own cup.
"Don't worry. It's only machine oil. Perfectly safe for you to consume."

She seemed unprepared and utterly enthralled by the fascinating melodies:

It started with sincerity and anticipation...
...followed by a passionate catharsis...
...with one climax after another...

...until the record's spinning came to a final stop and those hoarse shrieks were no longer audible.
"Mission accomplished."

21023.lore:
She got used to people losing their homes.
And she got used to people losing their lives.
But crying alone was useless.

"Wear this red scarf, and then we shall share each other's pain."
"We are family. We are Wildfire."

The moment that pair of big hands held her head, she could no longer hold back her tears.

The young boy took a short break from his sword practice.
The sunlight was baking his already heated neck. He slowly got into the water, whose coldness touched his bare feet.
When the bell chimes and birds tweet, even the people far away would know that springtime had arrived.

21025.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21025.lore:
The wings of the paper kite in her hands were broken, brutally reminding her of her beloved's tragic passing.
She kneeled next to the fire of war, eyes full of sorrow.

"If you are the only one left to do this, then our sacrifice would..."

Gunfire raged on, painting the sky red without dampening its majesty.
She looked up at the sky, eyes full of fury.

21026.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21026.lore:
Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it screw up its nose and sniff around and dive into an empty path.

Pity that no one has seen it...
Seen it retract its claws, enter the password, and leap into the embraces of freedom.

Has nobody seen it still...?
A grown dog can now walk itself in space!

21027.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21027.lore:
Though the table is set...
Some people want a cup of tea first.
Some people want to take a picture first.
Some people want to read the newspaper first.
Some people want to write a page in their notebook first.
Some people want to play on their phone first.

"All of you, eat while the food is hot!"

21028.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Abundance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21028.lore:
Lighting a light, she glanced at her friend beside her while holding a mug of warm chocolate.
Watching her read the books and notes she gifted her.
Watching her expressing a rare smile.

In cold nights like this, even the tiniest bit of bliss can chase away the chills.

21029.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
21029.lore:
She had once thought it was some sort of program. How else would it never tire?
But a program would never actively discard the optimal solution and bypass her trap.

"Seems like we'll have a war of attrition."
She yawns.

"Time to sleep. Organic lifeforms should treasure rest."
The surroundings dim.

She suddenly bolts awake, but the residues of data are swept away and destroyed. It all seems like a dream
— but the taste of defeat is very real.

21030.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.

The girl could rock any outfit she chooses, but she was unsatisfied, judging by the dozen sets of clothing piled up behind her.

"Will this be the last outfit for today?"

She thought silently to herself and looked at the girl in the mirror. She looked extra happy on this day.

"Okay! This is me!"

He immediately falls in love with the golden vessel and is about to buy it,
but the foxian girl drags him aside and whispers:
"Please return at night, Mr. Benefactor, and make up your mind then."

As promised, he returns at night.
The same foxian girl opens the door and smiles at him.
"Please follow me, Mr. Benefactor."

A ray of moonlight shines onto the base of the etched plate.
The artisan had traced the petals with lines of various depths, and he would not be able to see such details without the moonlight.

He finally recalls why this item is called "Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds."

"You don't believe me?"
He provocatively looks at the man before him, then draws out a revolver, empties its cylinder, and leaves a single shot in the chamber.

"Seems like I'll need to get you up to speed on how I do things if our cooperation were to remain amicable."

He pulls the trigger repeatedly, and the smile on his face remains the same after three empty clicks.
"Life is a grand gamble, and I'll always be the final victor."

21038.lore:
"Package secured. I'll leave covering our retreat to you."
Their comrade's voice comes through the communicator.

They glance around the surroundings, watching as the savaged remnants of their enemies continue to pass through the complex architecture inside the vast and abandoned structure. They are drawing ever closer.
"Please hold."

After a beat of quietude, a series of apocalyptic explosions rocket up into the sky. Waves of displaced air cast clouds of dust high across the battlefield, and smoke scatter in all directions, the blinding white cleaving light into the night.
"You know they purposely planted loads of gunpowder in there, right?"

With a rustle, they flung open the cape as if they just finished a leisurely stroll.
"Of course."
"So, let's light it up. All I need to do is play the part of the match."

21043.lore:
"Big brother, what's this..."
"It's been so long since you sang with joy... I've built a stage for you, though it's... a bit rudimentary."
"But the teacher thinks I'm not cut out for this..."
"Nonsense, I think you sound amazing! And your dreams will definitely come true. You deserve to sing on a bigger stage..."
...

Many years later, she stood on a dazzling stage, looking at the surging fans below, but lost herself for a moment...
On the long journey of chasing dreams, she would always remember that trusting gaze and her first "concert."
No glamorous lights, no elaborate makeup, just a child building a stage to encourage another child to pursue their dreams.

"Now, our dreams have come true. But... are they still 'our' dreams?"
She tightened her grip on the microphone. Before the next song began, she didn't even have time to feel sad.

21044.lore:
Their dance glides gracefully, shadows and light silently exchanging places. She takes the other person's hand, her smile beaming into those indifferent eyes.
"Beautiful Ranger... Welcome to the stage of the Remembrance. At this proximity... you are far more enchanting than one might perceive."

The surroundings darken, a beam of light cascading from the dome above, tracing their evolving steps.
"However, some were meant to dance with us but have yet to arrive..."

In a spinning moment, she draws closer to that expressionless face, grips that cold hand, and softly inquires—
"Tell me. What have you done?"

As their dance steps grow hurried more and more, fragmented snippets of the past rush into her mind through their joined fingertips.
In a past that stretches back further and further, she hears the sound of rain and the lamentations just before life's extinguish. Then, she sees her dance partner holding a blood-red paper umbrella in the drizzling rain. Finally, as far as her eyes can see—

A field of drowned corpses bobbing in the deluge.

Panic-stricken, she tries to withdraw her hand, falling backward.
The surroundings brighten again, the banquet's clamor resurfacing. Her dance partner gently supports her waist, as if oblivious to the ordeal that just unfolded.
"What a lovely dance that was, Memokeeper. Shall we have another go?"

21045.lore:
The eternal dream he longed for vanished in an instant. As he plummeted towards the earth, he felt no sadness, only a desire to close his eyes.

The old path treaded upon has now crumbled, yet the journey ahead remains shrouded in mist.
"After the awakening, the world continues its cycle of suffering, with no escape, the same as always..."
He carries the past, turns his back on his homeland, and continues towards a paradise that does not yet exist.

So, why do people slumber? And why do they wake?
— As planets streak past outside the window, this answer now demands a new meaning to be given.
"Maybe... just maybe I still can..."

Dawn's first light whispers. In the stillness of the flower grove, a shifting form dances, startling birds into flight one after another.

Silently reciting sword techniques, she moves with the flow, her once-clumsy moves now gaining finesse. Where the sword's cuts rend the air, petals fall like rain, swirling chaotically as they fall. Unbeknownst to her, the cool mist has dampened her hair.

 "Nice swordplay!"

Behind her, a young {F#woman}{M#man} with gray hair lowers the camera in hand.
 "Beautiful memories won't just fade away with the wind."

The Titankins' all-consuming roars sweep across the battlefield. Two lightning-quick figures slaughter their way out of combat.

"I alone will be enough to handle them."
Every punch unleashed by the warrior sends spears of blood through the bodies of the enemy.
"Brute force and nothing more. Watch my blade!"
As a blade of pale silver slices in a curve, monsters drop like falling leaves.
"A contest of speed?"
The two charge at the other side simultaneously.
Howls of anguish sound as the stealthy beasts behind them are struck down at once.
Two voices can be heard at the same time.
"That was my kill!"

21051.lore:
"Congratulations. Experiment failed again, didn't it?"
"..."
"I told you before that there are mistakes in your method."
"..."
"I gotta tell you, I've been getting some big breakthroughs recently..."

The aloof woman lifts her head from her book...
"I'm sorry. What did you say?"
She waves her hand.
"Well, I can't say how great these breakthroughs are. They might only affect half the cosmos."
The woman closes her book.
"Let's hear it, then."

"Hmph. A genius of my caliber... it's not something you'll just get to hear randomly..."
"I understand. I'll make some pastries. We can talk and eat at the same time."
