226004.lore: A decorative frame exclusively granted to the winner of the match. This is the "Emperor," symbolizing a supreme and unrivaled authority.

226005.lore: A decorative frame exclusively granted to the winner of the match. This is the "Rook," symbolizing an unyielding spirit.

227001.desc: A wreath that Amphoreus offered to {NICKNAME}.
227001.lore:
The laurel leaves praise your wisdom, the gold reflects your nobility, and this stands as proof that you once belonged here.

"From this day forth, your name shall no longer be your own alone, mortals will swear by your name.
Wear this glorious yet lonely laurel crown, hero... and merge into the pages of the epic."

227002.desc: A hairpin modeled after one of Ruan Mei's creations.
227002.lore:
There might have been many noble trash cakes in history, and you just wish you could all go anywhere together...

"Pat the left paw to turn left, pat the right paw to turn right. Pat the tail to brake. Let's go!"

227003.lore:
"They say that at amusement parks on other planets, cute animal friends are always a kid's favorite."
"This Mem hood is gonna be a bestseller for sure!"
"Hmm, but doesn't it make the wearer look a little... puffy?"

227004.desc: A holographic screen prop that hovers above the head, featuring a built-in set of "emoti" expressions that play on random shuffle.
227004.lore:
"Trailblazer, what do you make of this?"

"Aw, don't look at me, look up."

227005.desc: A headpiece modeled after the wispae "Golden Youth." People's regrets over unfinished business from their youth have coalesced into this little guy.
227005.lore:
Ten years later, you can't bring yourself to open that tiny gift box you'd long forgotten. You worry there might be an unopened letter inside, but you're equally afraid it's just a gift.

"I still remember running beneath the sunset that day... that was the youth I lost!"

227006.desc: Adorable headband styled after Sparkly Rabbit and Fire Shroom.
227006.lore:
A popular product from Sparxie's livestream. According to some Sparxheads, it occasionally makes a "Mwah!" sound.

"Whoa, it even makes sounds! Sparxie really puts her heart into these!"
"Huh... Oh... So that's how it is... Hahaha!"

227007.desc: The classic "Loading" icon you see everywhere, now with some snazzy light effects.
227007.lore:
When it hangs over your head, it buys you a little more time for reflection.

"Trailblazer, what do you think?"

227008.desc: An origami mask styled like a raccoon. Handle with care.
227008.lore:
A temporary Supplicant mask designed by Evanescia for {NICKNAME}, in a raccoon style befitting only the protagonist.

Now come. Let me make you... more of a "{RUBY_B#raccoon}protagonist{RUBY_E#}."

227009.desc: A pair of futuristic cat-ear headphones with a bold, adorable design, glowing with a signature pink neon light. The perfect proof that you've made it as a top streamer.
227009.lore: "Since you've decided to become the Astral Express's official game streamer, then... hehe, put these headphones on! Mm-hmm! Not bad, not bad. You're really starting to look the part! Pink totally suits you too, just like I said it would."

227010.desc: A pair of tall, slender pink fox ears set on a headband, their edges adorned with delicate silver metal accents and crafted with exceptional care.
227010.lore:
Evanescia has long made a habit of wearing The Fluffy's matching headpiece, happily roaming conventions. Still, nothing compares to seeing her idol wearing the pink fox ears that represent her.

"Wait... that's my look... It is, right!? I'm not imagining this? *click*! That's way too cute! Okay, one more shot! I'm printing this and keeping it by my bed!"

227012.desc: Featuring a wide frame and eye-catching orange-tinted lenses, these Furbobocom special-issue goggles are made to protect your eyes in the chaos of breaking news on site.
227012.lore:
A go-to piece of gear for furbo journalist Furbulitzer, its oversized lenses said to be especially effective at blocking coworkers' jealous stares.

"So it's leading the Press Corps, and even the president's wearing the same pair? Beepboop, that was the wrong call..."

227013.desc: With translucent, multicolored lenses and blue-pink flame effects along the edges, these retro arcade-style glasses are, by appearance alone, almost a perfect 1:1 match to the original.
227013.lore: "So you were expecting HP bars, weaknesses, and loot to pop up? Yeah... no. They're just plain goggles with a holographic filter."

227015.desc: A ring formed of three clusters of karmic fire. When equipped, it hovers behind the wearer as a back accessory.
227015.lore: The flames of wrath ignites, proclaiming that he has cast aside his obsessions and vowed to point his honed blade — forged in rebirth and tempered a thousand times into its sharpest form — directly at the source of all tragedy.

227016.desc: A fan-made headwear exclusive to the Star Rail FEST booth. Its cool, restrained color palette and meticulous craftsmanship perfectly recreate the character's iconic face-covering design.
227016.lore:
A heartfelt creation from a hospitable stall owner, pressed into your hands in hopes of winning over yet another fan.

"Take this freebie, and we're officially kindred spirits! Go on, try it on!"

227017.desc: Sunglasses of the same model as Lyndon Skott's. Capable of blocking ultraviolet rays, harmful cosmic microwave background radiation, hostile stares, and tears of loneliness.

229001.desc: Features a black base with gold embroidery, with dragon patterns adorning the lapels and back, and traditional frog button closures on the inner garment.
229001.lore:
Upon seeing your confusion, Dan Heng explains the origin of this outfit.

"The Xianzhou has long held the tradition of welcoming each new year with fresh attire and renewed hopes. May the coming year bring you health without harm, friends without ills, and heaven's favor in all things."

23000.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23000.lore:
If you are concerned for the road, just look up again.
When the stars look gently down, the heart would already be soaring.
Every thought and every whisper,
becomes a life experience that would never leave.

23001.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23001.lore:
A young girl smiles subtly.
"How?"
"Right here, right now, I am alone..."
"But it feels... very lively."

23002.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23002.lore:
"Should a day come when even I'm not here anymore, please look after this database, Svarog."
(Who is this... Why is this message in my records...)
"Do you have something that's irreplaceable, Svarog?"
(Irreplaceable... broken parts... can simply be replaced...)
"You'll definitely find it one day, Svarog."
(Such things... will only cause trouble...)

"When that time comes... You should leave this place behind."

23003.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23003.lore:
"Remember, the war with the monsters cannot be won by retreating."
"We are the last defense, the final iron wall between them and Belobog..."
"We cannot retreat under any circumstances!"

She looks up to see the frozen earth and endless winter ahead.
Business as usual.
Only that... the figure at which she had been gazing is gone.

23004.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23004.lore:
"Welt...?"
"It's a... great name, right?"
"Then..."
"From now on, you are Welt."
"This Herrscher core... and the mission to protect the world..."
"I'll leave them to you, Welt."

23005.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23005.lore:
"If you want to cry after your loss, Gepard, then cry."
"But you need to stand back up even when you are crying, until you can defeat me... Even if it takes years."
A few years later, the boy no longer cried or lost to his sister.

Now on the battle field, the courageous Silvermane Guard captain will defend till the end no matter what
— all to find the moment to completely destroy the enemy.

23006.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23006.lore:
"Could it be that there's something you haven't told me?"

She watches as their neck stiffens, as if a lump is blocking their throat.
She knows she is feared, and that no further step is needed.
At this point, it no longer mattered what she said.
Any word she utters radiates horror...
They stand no chance against her, and have no choice but to blurt out what she wants to hear.

Like a spider waiting in its web, patience is all she needs.

23007.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23007.lore:
She leaves the cover of the awning, opens her umbrella, and dives into an alley while humming a lighthearted tune.
The rain stops a little while after.

She scratches her head and swipes her screen open. After a few taps, raindrops begin to fall in an area no wider than her umbrella.
The pitter-patter sound of raindrops on the umbrella mixes with music from the game. All was calm and relaxing.
"Gaming and rain totally go together."

23008.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Abundance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23008.lore:
Under the watch of the white irises, he knocks on the coffin.
"Sometimes I feel I underestimated you by proposing this deal."
He receives no response other than a thorny branch piercing through his palm.
Yet he smiles, and tightly grasps the thorn.

"Indeed. This is how it is. We wanted to use each other, and both ended up underestimating the other."

23009.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23009.lore:
He would come to this place every year, bringing new swords with him each time.
He had seen all the owners of the swords draw their last breath.
Every time he leaves, he would sorrowfully ponder...

When would his own blade be brought here by someone else?

23010.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23010.lore:
"Do not make this decision lightly, general... Think about how you will be remembered in history..."
The general of the Cloud Knights listens to his subordinates' words with eyes half-closed.
"History will make its own judgment, but I have no interest in my legacy."
"If I succeed, history will state that I am currently supremely confident in my masterful strategy."
"But if I fail, then history will state that I am currently neglecting my duties in wanton pleasure, preferring finches over my people."

A finch jumps down from his shoulder, and he extends his hand to catch the small creature.
"I have simply made my own decision."

23011.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23011.lore:
The ache in the middle of her forehead will accompany her for the rest of her life, but it is only a fraction of what she had experienced in the past.
She thought herself prescient until the departure of those for whom she cared.
She now "sees" the world ever-changing, the times ever-shifting...
But she already shut her eyes, because the future has already been determined
...inside "the third eye."

23012.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23012.lore:
The boy is still tightly grasping the sword even when fast asleep against the general's shoulder.
The general gently taps the boy's cheek, and the boy mutters in his sleep.
"General... I finally... won."

The general pauses. He suddenly realizes that, compared to the boy trying to improve every day,
he himself has endured too many years and is used to stagnation.

"You will soon be better than everyone, and that will only be the beginning..."

23013.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Abundance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23013.lore:
She had spent many days next to the window.

Flowers were blooming outside when she made gentle medicines with mint and nepeta.
Rain was falling outside when she made strong medicines with mosla and ginger.
Leaves were falling outside when she made sour medicines with peony roots and dry plums.
And snow was falling outside when she made bitter medicines with skullcaps and anemarrhena.

Time flows endlessly, but this window and the person sitting next to it remain forever the same.

23014.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23014.lore:
The blade shattered, plunging into the bone-chilling cold.
All earthly instruments are mere futilities, their worth discernible with a single glance.
"What use do I have of swords?"
She holds no attachment, nor does her gaze accommodate anything within.

"From now on, I shall be my own sword."
To transcend perceived precipices and achieve unprecedented breakthroughs,
one must regard themselves as "kindling" to fuel their own fire.

23015.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23015.lore:
From birth, all that ever lay before him was but a lightless dungeon.
To this darkness, irrelevant sins bound him... irrelevant memories engulfed him.
He writhed, gasping for breath with every fiber of his being,
attempting to clasp a sliver of light in this fathomless ocean.

Until the day the general stepped into the lightless depths of this prison,
he beheld a radiance shining brighter than the sun — the gaze of a young man.

23016.desc: Light Cone for the Path of the Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23016.lore:
For a competent IPC professional, "feeling overwhelmed" is absolutely not allowed.
Stand tall and take on whatever comes your way, be it burnout or overwork! 
Unless... it's being overwhelmed by "them."

"Oh, don't get so antsy! I only have two hands!"
A girl who just returned home from working overtime is pinned down by a group of fluffy creatures.
They may not fully understand her words, simply nuzzling their round heads closer to her palm.
The feeling of exhaustion gradually fades from her body, replaced by the warmth and comfort brought by stroking their fur.

23017.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Abundance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23017.lore:
The girl hides behind the door and dares not move one step closer. 
Perhaps due to the fact that tonight's objective is already within her reach, her heart is actually beating faster.
"I'm not scared, not scared, not scared..."
In darkness, silence lets out a piercing scream.

The girl is shivering and grasps the "weapon" in her hands tight, but still does not dare to approach the "target."
"There is nothing to be s—s—scared of!"

The tail behind her has finally had enough and suddenly lights up.
"Hurry up. You're just picking up a delivery!"

23018.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23018.lore:
He once heard a ballad, singing in praise of that sliver of light:
Rose blooms, to answer THEIR smile.
Dawn shines, to illuminate THEIR visage.
Melody plays, to banish THEIR fatigue.

But, light, once gone, never returns. Yet, he still gallops to the far beyond.
All that is needed is to wait for, to believe in, and to preach about everything that is of the Beauty in this cosmos.
Even if everything is but a fleeting instant before a gaze, he has already found the answer he sought.

23019.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23019.lore:
She once loved to seal the moment when plum blossoms were on the verge of wilting and keep them close to her.
It has been many years since then. Many lifeforms — rambunctious, sweet, and everything in between — have bloomed from her hands, but the plum blossoms still wilt at their preordained times.
It has been many years since then. Her visage in the mirror seems untouched by time. But, in the grand scheme of the cosmos, is she too destined to last for but a fleeting moment?

"If all is set for eventual demise, what purpose, then, does creation serve?"
After a silence that seems to stretch to eternity, the winds blow, the petals fall, and the reflection in the mirror tenders the same answer as always.
"For the day when plum blossoms are no longer kept."
She deftly caresses the icy surface of the mirror. Such soliloquies have happened too many times for her to count.

23020.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23020.lore:
The afternoon sunshine is just right, and the floral scents fill the air.
Though he tries to keep his thoughts pure, cognitive stagnancy inevitably attracts particulates of mind like gathered dust.

"Healing one's thoughts is just as vital as the maintenance of one's health."
The fools' clamoring fades alongside fatigue as he sinks into the water, letting all thoughts loose, his mind elucidated and ordered.

"Truth eludes all filths, accepting only those of pure thoughts."

23021.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23021.lore:
Just as fireworks can flicker, she too can shift between ten different colors in a minute.

When the light show nears its end, she sits high above, regarding the bustling masses beneath her feet with boredom.
Thoughts flow and vanish, and slyness circulates across myriad eyes like a dancing kaleidoscope.
"I've made my decision. This is how we're going to have fun today!"

Bouncing and hopping, she glides through the crowds, her golden-red tail flitting in and out of sight.
"Keep up! The brightest fireworks are just about to begin!"

23022.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23022.lore:
Light the candles, spread the cards, breathe in the fragrance...
These broken memories become faces in the dancing light.
The apparitions that emerge from flames tell her of pasts fondly recalled.
Time is shorn. The moment is frozen. She turns these most precious instants into crystallizations of eternity.

"There is too much lost, and too little that remains... We nurture remembrance against the cruelties of time."

23023.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23023.lore:
With the final card revealed, despondency, rage, acceptance, and sangfroid... A cascade of emotions drops onto the faces of his opponents.
"Now that we're all here, why don't we spice things up a bit?"
He puts in all his chips. Those who have cut their losses leave the table, cursing profanities and secretly hoping that he would lose.

Victories, reputation, fortune... He cares not for any of that. Instead, he's enthralled only by those moments that make his very life quiver —
After all, hell is but one choice away from heaven.

The chips are cast, sorrow fills the air, and the illusory sense of satisfaction dissipates in an instant when the dust finally settles.
"All or nothing, I have not the luxury of choice..."

23024.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23024.lore:
Flowing in the narrow border between "existence" and "nothingness," the ice-cold tides eternally lap against the shores and bring all things to their final end.

In this place, the drowned ask for help, lament with songs, find their happiness, enjoy sweet moments, and suffer great agony... All these are reflected in the water. She cannot experience these, but she can feel them —
There are still many roads to walk, many sounds to listen to, and many things to change before she arrives at the end.

She reaches out and saves the drowning from the temptations of Nihility, and one mirage after another bursts apart behind her figure.
She keeps walking in this boundless world, all for an end that does not exist.

— And it's always raining here.

23025.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23025.lore:
This is the edge of the Asdana system. The ocean of memoria roars with mountainous waves and she, like a singular tiny spark, may be doused at any moment in the storm.
"For one who cannot dream to enter the Synesthesia Dreamscape, they would have to pay a price comparable to death."
She can still hear her companions' concerned voices next to her ears. She takes a deep breath and dives into the Memory Zone.
As the vessel silently sinks into the depth of the Memory Zone, small pinpricks of firefly lights dissipate from the cracks and are then immediately swallowed up by the endless darkness.

"Wherefore do you hurtle unto death?"
In the ocean of memoria that grows deeper and deeper, the weak light emitted by the Memory Zone creatures are like faraway eyes that nonchalantly glance at her.

Dreams remained too distant for her. She gazes emptily out at the boundless darkness, her body and soul having reached the breakdown threshold long ago under the heavy pressure of memoria. Though she realizes her consciousness is gradually fading, only those remaining memories are playing over and over in her brain —
The Swarm that covered the sky tore through the frontline defenses as she flew towards the Swarm while enveloped in fire. The charred ash of the Swarm faded like snow, under which lies the pitch-black carcasses of the knights.
She didn't even have the time to take a bouquet and offer her final acknowledgement to knights, who were dying one after another. Their lives bloomed in the blink of an eye and went out equally fleetingly. Like a string of genetic code, they never possessed names and only had numbers allotted instead.

"Wherefore do you live?"
In the deathly silence, like flames dissolving in the sea, she is reduced to a singular spot of fire and unendingly progresses towards the light...
She opens her eyes after what seems to be forever. She sees the "future" looking like a pearl, radiating with a soft and vague light. Tears stream down her face —
"I do it to find... my own 'dream'..."

23026.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23026.lore:
Time flows through the mirror, metamorphosing the once inexperienced little girl into a seasoned songstress.
She studies her reflection in the mirror. Time has altered all but her green eyes, which still remain as serene as a lake, as if recounting an unshakable faith.

"You seem in high spirits today."
"Yes... after all, there's a very important 'performance'."
"Indeed. The Charmony Festival's rehearsal is about to start. Please head to the preparation room."
...

She steps out from the dressing room, leaving behind the brilliant lights of the theater, fading into the distance.
"My stage lies not here."
She closes her eyes, letting the night swallow her silhouette.
"From the past to the present, my song has always been for..."
"For those who have lost hope."

23027.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23027.lore:
He felt as if he had fallen into a deep sea. Everything was departing from him, leaving only his hollow thoughts writhing and struggling all alone.

Terror, anxiety, loneliness, darkness, rage — these feelings didn't dissipate with his physical body, but remained within the mechanical shell in a different manner — and they were even heavier than before.

He heard the call of the dead, smelled the scent of something being charred, the whirl of machinery buzzed around his ears, and the new blue blood flew towards his thirsty heart... Some cruel memories resurfaced as the unforgettable hatred turned into a weak light in the darkness. He followed the light to walk toward the end of it all, exerting every ounce of his strength to rise once again to the surface.

He opened his eyes and a flash of fireworks darted past before hearing the doctor's congratulations — 
"Welcome to this world, once again."
He balled his hands into fists — hands that were now made of cold iron...
He would no longer live for himself.

23028.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23028.lore:
"Lady Bonajade, if it weren't for your continuous supply of goods and donations, the orphanage would probably..."
She gently stroked the children's heads, cutting off the director's words.
"As long as I'm here, there's no need to worry about the days ahead... And there's no need to say these things to the children, it only adds to their worries."

The children looked up, chattering with her about recent happenings, their worries, and their dreams.
"Lady Bonajade, when are you gonna come visit us again?"
"Don't work too hard, and make sure you get lotsa sleep..."
"Lady Bonajade, when I grow up, I want to be someone like you!"
She looked at the children's clear eyes and paused for a moment.
"Someone like me..."
The child handed her an apple, "Yes! Someone who brings light and hope to others!"

Poverty, demerits, sorrow, suffering... She walked among the galaxies, taking others' pledges and giving equivalent returns.
Life exists for desire, runs on it, and dies from it — this is an irrefutable law, as well as an inevitability of life itself.
A philanthropist with a hidden agenda, a villainous merchant who mortgages souls... She was labeled by the world in many such ways, yet only she understood the true morals behind these actions.

23029.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23029.lore:
After a few sudden drizzles, spring tides rise, birthing lush greenery.
"How many springs has it been?"
He recalls those young soldiers heading to the battlefield for the first time. Year after year, the faces were all different, yet they radiated the exact same vigor and hope.
The willow withers as it waits for their return. But what they manage to bring home is often... the frost that can never melt.

Birds' warbles linger in the air as he closes his eyes, allowing sunlight to fall on his face through the gaps between the leaves.
—"Alas, those who remain are the loneliest of all."

23030.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23030.lore:
In the resplendent twilight, a swift figure darts across the rooftops.

"Lili, Guoguo, let's see who makes it to the finish line first!"
Scaling the eaves, evading the guards, swaying with the wind, the girl moves like a nimble critter, chasing the last sliver of sunlight.

The warm evening breeze caresses her face, and the setting sun bathes the cat in a kaleidoscope of colors.
"You guys won!"
She declares, wiping sweat from her brow and cradling the cat in her arms.
Amidst a rising galaxy of stars, her unguarded smile dissolves into a bloom of innocence, akin to the layered twilight hues adrift in the sky.

23031.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23031.lore:
"Pitiful, laughable slaves..."
The Denizens of Abundance's legions come crashing upon the border like an avalanche, with Lupitoxin rushing toward the Verdant Knights like a tide, trying to arouse the deep-set fear hidden in the soldiers' hearts. Illusions of dread came forth, striking the wills of the warriors, compelling them to drop their blades and be seized by hesitation.
But the front remains stalwart like a bronze wall, unstirred by the borisins' disdainful words. From among the soldiers, a single figure saunters forth.
She moves her body at a slow pace, and the flags behind her rustle under the unseen killing intent.
"The general... it's the general..."
"General Feixiao..."
"The Merlin's Claw!"
These small cheers and calls then come together into a thunderous battle cry.

"Always soaring! Forever triumphant!"
She stands there, alone. A single figure, but imbued with the might of an entire army.

23032.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Abundance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23032.lore:
"First, overhaul the department's work habits."
"Then, strictly implement rewards and penalties."
"Of course, the most important part is figuring out everyone's tangled web of personal interests as soon as possible..."
Though she was originally here to admire the scenery, her mind had unknowingly drifted toward work, with stress and trouble naturally following.

She hurriedly ignites the soothing incense she always carried with her.
"The world is so beautiful, yet I am so irritable... Best not to think of such miserable matters while on vacation..."

23033.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23033.lore:
Somewhere in the Ninja Realm, a shroud of dreary gray veils the city.

"Hiyaaa!"
A young lady darts through the monsters, her vibrant silhouette cutting through the darkness like a stroke of paint against a moonless earth.

In the midst of smoke, the Evil Ninjas wince in both agony and disbelief.
"Who...are you...?"
"I'm Ninja Rappa! A beacon of determination, eradicating evil and upholding justice."
The Evil Ninjas exchange hesitant glances, eyes wide as they attempt to flee.
"Are you prepared to recite your final rhymes?"
Her shuriken dances through the air, a flurry of light and steel, overwhelming her adversaries with its blinding swiftness.
"Secret Technique: Dazzling Obliteration!"

The explosion behind her shatters the night, unveiling the city's wounds.
With a breath drawn deep, she launches herself into the neon-lit distance, where the vibrant lights scream like a heavy metal chorus.
"Such loathsome evil spirits. The Dazzling Ninja's ultimate hunt shall continue..."

23034.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23034.lore:
Those delusions and fallacies have been shattered. He wanted to be the sun of the whole world, yet he fell from the sky.

"Now, do you feel what pain is?"
Another voice in his heart spoke thus.
"Yes. And that is what I deserve to feel."
He fell into dust and answered himself with his heavy footsteps.

He walked on the earth and once again beheld the agony that covers the mortal realm like a never-ending font.
He stepped over the thorns that blocked the road and listened to the calls of humanity. He experienced anguish, through which he obtained tranquility.

"Falling was originally just another name for flying."
And on this eighth day, he granted himself "departure."

23035.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23035.lore:
"Who... Is she?" The girl caresses the unfamiliar self.

She recalls how the fire that day had swallowed her whole, and how her bejeweled fan turned into ash.

She had once walked on a never-ending road, looking for the light ahead.
The sounds outside were calling for her, leading her forward, guiding her through the layers of night.
The sounds within reminded her of those unfulfilled promises, unexecuted plans, and unrealized wishes... They were all still waiting for her.

They never dissipated in the fire, but instead, glowed ever brighter in the flames.

"That is me..."
She stands at the end of the road and no longer looks back in reminiscence —
"It's the original me, and also the brand-new me."

23036.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23036.lore:
"This strand, a soldier's sacrifice."
"This strand, a hero's growth."
"This strand, the city's prosperity."
....
The Garmentmaker pulls at the threads using a needle, everything held between her fingers.
"The destiny of certain heroes has already been severed..."
She scoops up another set of golden threads and continues her mending.
"The fates of certain heroes must continue..."

The divine loom weaves on, and the Garmentmakers dance with lively grace. Eons of time had already passed through the loom, and she has long been accustomed to such waiting....

For the sake of turning time to golden "inspiration."

23037.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23037.lore:
"The Intelligentsia Guild's letters have been handled."
"The Simulated Universe is functioning normally..."
"Literary collections have been reprinted."
"Hey. Shhh. Don't bother Madam Herta..."

...Within a great tower on the edge of the cosmos, puppets work methodically, dealing with all manner of chores in anticipation of her arrival.
Time passes. Countless people drift through the canvas of time like meteors streaking across the night sky, bright for an instant, before ultimately returning to silence.
"Madam Herta hasn't shown herself in a long time..."
"Is she still thinking...?"

"Hmmm. Thought this would all be done after discovering a few axioms?"
She stretches, lifting her head from the calculations, and another thought surfaces in her mind...
"Nothing is irrefutable. I will chase these questions to the end!"

23038.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23038.lore:
"Mama, I want to hear another story!"

"My sweet girl, how about a story about time?"

"Time... what is it?"

"Time, my dear, is like a flower."

"Like the dandelions blooming in the fields?"

"Yes, just like dandelions. Time grows, blossoms, and bears fruit. We call its petals 'moments.'"

"And then what happens?"

"Then, it withers into a thousand pieces, leaving seeds that drift everywhere..."

"Mama, does that mean it becomes the 'future'?"

"Guess what it turns into after that?"

"It turns into so many flowers, blooming into a vibrant sea of blossoms, right?"

The mother didn't have time to answer as the sunlight from the window warmed the girl's face. That gentle figure vanished once more into her dream.
She opened her eyes—
"If time were a flower..." she murmured.
"It would surely become a sea of flowers," said the serene girl.
"Of course it would!" Exclaimed the playful girl, cheering at her masterpiece.

23039.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23039.lore:
Cold dew congealed on the blade, sliding down in crimson streaks.
The rust-tainted wilderness still flickered with embers of battle, flames leaping upon the ashes.

"Mydeimos, that was a godlike fight just now!"
A bare-chested warrior wiped his weapon clean, shouting in exhilaration.

"Mydei, one day, I'll be as invincible as you!"
A child gazed at him with reverence, clutching a broken sword in small hands.

"Crown Prince, our return to Castrum Kremnos is within sight."
An aged man smiled, raising his cup in a toast to him.

He nodded silently and walked to the edge of the camp.
The pain of rebirth still coursed across his skin. Tomorrow, he would lead the Kremnoan Detachment forth once again, migrating to foreign lands.
Where this wandering would end, he did not know. The only certainty was this — he would bear the duty of a king until the blood and flames consumed him.

As night deepened, he drank the bloodwine alone. A passing bard plucked at his strings, a wandering melody drifting through the air—
"Home is the land of dreams, not a place one can ever reach."

23040.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23040.lore:
Another farewell ceremony was underway.
A young girl, stepping on broken moonlight, wove a garland of parting by the riverbank.

Ancient laments crystallized in the cold air, while the quiet river flowed into a distant land of blossoms.
Blood-stained scrolls, rusted long swords, handkerchiefs embroidered with poetry... She accepted their remains, along with the tales of their lives.

"My eyes are like lenses, forever longing for the starry sky."
—An epitaph dedicated to the departed scholar.
"For life and for death, the knight grants only a cold glance."
—The maxim that the nameless warrior upheld all his life.
"Life is nothing but death, aglow with shimmering light."
—The final verse penned by the eternal-seeking poet with his life.
...

"Every flower once bloomed with pride..."
Accompanied by the river's soft lament, she offered the departed poems, garlands, and remembrances—
"If withering is inevitable, at least let our farewell be... a little more beautiful."

23041.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23041.lore:
In that hidden experiment, various illusions constantly surged forward, pulling at his steps.

The seductive whispers beckoned him to give up on that treacherous topic, for what reason was there to gamble his life?
The cold, threatening voice declared that those who walk the edge of life and death will ultimately burn their lives away.
Then there were the angry accusations, shouting to cast the blasphemer — the one who had desecrated the gods — into an execution grounds most cruel.

"The performance of life, too, must eventually reach the curtain call."

He closed his eyes, grasped the divine flame, and let the pain drown his fading soul.
First, his resolute gaze. Then, his beating heart. The complete soul... He threw himself willingly into that most pure and intense flame to be used for the smelting—

The voices bubbled and then became silent.
In the darkness, the brilliant truth began to take shape in his hands.

23042.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23042.lore:
"Emotions are like clouds, and we are the sky that carries them. If the sky is overcast, then our emotions will fluctuate all over."
The physician listens with care to the visitor's sorrows, offering words of gentle solace.
"Please close your eyes and breathe slowly... Imagine yourself in a warm and soft place..."

As if infused with magic, a seven-colored rainbow radiance spills from beneath the wings of the winged beast.
"A breeze would drift across the plains, carrying the fragrance of wildflowers. Moist clouds would pass by, laden with sunlight..."
The visitor gradually sinks into a peaceful dream, responding only with the quiet rhythm of steady breaths.

After seeing the last patient, the physician gently closes the door of the ward.

In the distance, the boundless evernight still surges, with many ruins standing like the scars of the earth.

"In the next life, may dawn shine upon all..."
Before departing, she makes a wish to the sky —
"May the sky forever hold that rainbow radiance."

23043.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23043.lore:
The cat-eared girl stretches her limbs on the rooftop, slinking into the night.
In the treasure vault that had slumbered for a thousand years, she glides effortlessly, gathering precious treasures into her embrace before vanishing without a sound.
"Foolish fate could never catch me!"

The wind through the ruins carries the scent of the wild, rustling her hood.
Resting her head against the cold stone, she swallows a bite of rough, dry rations, idly tossing a gold coin between her fingers.

A faint sound from afar reaches her ears. In that holy city bathed in dawn's light, the bustling crowds still revel in warmth and celebration.
"How much longer... a year, or ten thousand?"

She stretches with a lazy yawn, casting her restless thoughts aside.
"Hah, Cifera always has the last laugh!"

A golden streak of lightning cuts across the sky, and her proclamation lingers in the wind—
Just as it had a thousand years ago.

23044.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23044.lore:
Once again, at the journey's end, the man's silhouette was swallowed by the sweltering golden sun.

"So... that golden blood, the last hope of deliverance, was really..."

His tears never had the chance to fall — they vanished into steam.
"Snowy, see you tomorrow!"
"Deliverer, remember to stay alive till the final act!"
"Go be the dawn of Amphoreus..."

...
The people's wishes echoed in the void. The Nameless Hero crumbled, his fierce and tragic death laid bare.

"If rage can't burn this twisted fate to ashes..."
He climbed toward the peak, over and over, only to fall and be shattered, again and again—

"Then let me burn with it!"

23045.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23045.lore:
The girl's ears rang in the fantasia with the words conversed on that day.

"This sword wasn't hard to pull out at all, Merlin."
"Indeed. Becoming the king everyone wishes for won't be hard for you at all, given that I'm guiding you. However, Altria... The hard part is that you can't always meet everyone's expectations."
"Then they can choose a more fitting king by that time. I won't protest."
"But what if such a person will never exist?"
"...Then I'll do my best to meet everyone's expectations."

Now, the girl had long since become aware of how profound that tragedy would be. Would she have chosen to give up if she were to return to that moment where everything began?

The king does not speak and simply grasps the sword tightly.
The stone again gives out a thundering roar as the sword is pulled out.

23046.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23046.lore:
The flames of karma ignite the plains. The ideals of unknowns turn to ashes, as the ideals of others burn passionately.

The Guardian traverses between bullets and arrowheads.
He can save no one here. He can save everyone here.

Kill one person to save one person. Kill ten thousand to save ten thousand. The fate of trampling over our peers is one part of humanity's continued existence.

The Guardian had already grown used to all this, and his steps never hesitated.
The determination that covers his legs is like wind. The determination that covers his arms is like fire.

He is still seeking a miracle that can bring forth salvation.

23047.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23047.lore:
Waves surge forth, their roar echoing across the heavens.
Fish swim through the empty seas, where ancient foam churns and that melody seems to still linger.

"Noble Princess, feast with us!"
Answering the deep sea's call, she danced with the black tide until she alone remained on that grand stage.

"Swordmaster of the seas, why do you stay silent, what makes you sing?"
With every step upon the Earth, she endured the pain, rarely singing, only her crimson blade sang the lament of life.

"Dux Gladiorum, come with me to conquer the starry seas!"
When she found this blazing light, she finally took up her bow, believing it to be the start of the celebration.

...

"Helektra... Helektra... when your song ends, where will you swim to next?"

When futile hopes shatter, she always answers their questions with a solitary melody, yet it enchants all who hear it.

Or perhaps... whether in the mortal realm or the deep sea, the only true listener is the performer herself.

23048.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Harmony. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23048.lore:
"How will history remember Cerydra a thousand years from now?"
She was once asked.

To some, she was the eminent "Imperator."
That cold and cruel tyrant, that ambitious "Flamecrowned," that empress who burned the Old Era with blood and fire...

Others argued she was merely a pitiful "pawn."
This forsaken ruler was but a prisoner of ambition, destined to lose everything in that game of chess against the gods.

And some said that in the depths of her heart, darker than the ocean's abyss, she was just a mortal named "Cerydra."
One who mourned for fallen comrades, who hesitated and feared before her heavy fate, unable to move forward...

"Heh. There is no need for history to remember me..."

Swallowing the bitterness in her heart, she continued down that path of Flame-Chase paved with sacrifice.

"It is our burning golden blood that shall engrave it!"

23049.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23049.lore:
In the crevices of time, only her heartbeat echoes.
Like many nights before, watching in the darkness and resting in dormancy.

She treasures the memories entrusted to her.
The girl sets forth from a blank starting point, painting each stop she lingered at with vibrant colors. A cozy Express, companions each with their unique personalities, dazzling and magnificent planets... like a dream too beautiful to leave behind.

"My real journey starts now!"
The girl's declaration seems to whisper right beside her ear.

She gazes toward the distant starry sky, as a beam of light approaches.
It's the Express's headlight, like a shooting star.

"Good night, March... When you awaken, continue on your Trailblaze journey ♭"

As the memoria tide surges, she buries her wish deep in her heart, those tiny whispers and that light
—she has never forgotten.

23050.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23050.lore:
"Come, come to me..."
A vivid memory, guided by flames, envelops her body and soul.

The bygone days had fallen into the grave, is that true?
"Hush, don't weep, don't resist..."
She brands herself onto others' hearts, as strange gazes gradually turn familiar.
"Do you remember now?"

As the embers of old memories scatter away, her face carries a trace of intoxicating floral fragrance...
"I am your memory."

23051.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23051.lore:
In the boundless ancient lands, a young man walks alone on his quest.
He seems to return to those wandering days, wading through surging waves, weathering wind and frost, battling behemoths, struggling against raging tides.

Yet in those moments of respite, he is not alone.
Though worlds apart, he can still see the light ahead...

It is the light of hope of all living beings.
The shattered earth can no longer sustain new life, and the newborn creatures gather around him, seeking comfort and shelter.

Those are the words his companions left in his heart, like an endless voyage connecting them firmly together.

The troubles of his past may stir with the wind, but the path he's traveled will become the strength for his metamorphosis.

"I will stand guard for the Path of the Trailblaze."
The young man leaps forth with his spear, advancing toward the light

"And I shall defend all hope that threatens to fade away!"

23052.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23052.lore:
The azure sky reflects a brilliant tomorrow.
One step, two steps... the maiden's path has been so long, but fortunately those cherished stories haven't been forgotten by the cycles of time.
Now, written together by everyone, the epic has been completed, welcoming its finale.

Stars, flowers, birds, and a beautiful new world.
Gauze, wreaths, long dresses, and the wind that carries blessings.
The quest of thirty million lifetimes transformed into a single moment of happiness, enough to outweigh an eternity of words.

"Hee, it's a promise..."
The girl turns around to give a gentle smile.
"One of us stays in the past, and the other walks toward the future... but our hearts have never been apart ♪"

She rises onto her toes and steps into the past.
And memory, transforming into ripples of past reverie, drifts toward tomorrow.

23053.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Elation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23053.lore:
When she laughs, her fans laugh.
When she cries, her fans shed tears.
When she's angry, her fans rage.

"Cute, playful, popular. Sparxie is everything I want to be..."
"Don't be fooled, Sparxie is a poison, she's a lie..."
"I'll follow Sparxicle forever, she gave me the courage for rebirth..."
"Sparxie should vanish from this world!"
...

Clicks, bullet comments, discussions... Sparxie burns ever brighter in everyone's eyes.

"I've received everyone's feelings~ I'll return them with the most passionate response~♥! For example..."

As the stream draws to a close, the young girl winks, as if she sees through the hearts of everyone behind their screens...

"Here's your chance! Would you choose to become the cutesy Sparxie?"

23054.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Elation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23054.lore:
Once again, within the Deca-Light Reflection Barrier, she watched as destiny intertwined like a shimmering web of pearls, reflecting and overlapping, with endless cause and effect.

"What do you see?"
Her master once asked her.

Some diviners saw their own insignificance, and no longer believed that human effort could change destiny.
Others saw the great tides of the future, following the flow to find optimal solutions.

At that moment, the young girl gazed into the barrier, and saw boundless darkness. That is a future long predetermined.
She also saw "starlight," the faint possibilities not yet devoured by the gods' gaze.

That gleam of starlight once slipped through her fingers, leaving the Fanghu in eternal night.
Yet she had also seized fleeting variables, flipping the Weal and Woe of the Yuque.

"A dead end is called such only because none dare defy fate."
She wanted to find her own answer, even if it meant stepping into destined peril.

"What I see matters not. What matters is what I can do."

23055.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Elation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23055.lore:
"Errant strokes corrected. Parameters adjusted."
She once tried to fit the curves of the sea into her artwork, extracting the form and spirit of water and analyzing the scattered specks of foam.
Time and again, countless waves bloomed from her brush, but none was the one she had imagined.

"I wish to paint for all: not to trace their footsteps, but to illustrate their path forward."
With a sweep of her brush, she brought shelter to famished children.
With a wash of ink, she mended the rifts between the sky and the earth with her strokes.
And her furthest stroke pierced the canvas of this world, extending into the vast cosmos.

For countless yesterdays, she painted the future for others...
The pale and the bleak, imbued with the color of hope.
Looking back, every stroke she laid down also shaped the "Pearl" within her heart.

23056.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23056.lore:
"What did Introduction to Detective Deduction say again? Unless absolutely necessary..."
Fangs woven in red and black crept inch by inch up his shoulder.

Where the night drowns deepest, clouds of doubt emerge. In the shadowed forest, vicious beasts lurk.
"This game of cat and mouse... it's time to end it."
The crimson fades. Moonlight still gleams silver across the sky, and the stars rest in peaceful slumber.

This is yet another one of his searches for the truth, but the shadows of the past tap his shoulder, then dissipate into nothing.
The maneuvering of this very moment continues, until—

"Until... the day retribution falls upon the wicked."

23057.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Elation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23057.lore:
Above the city, a girl's flamboyant figure bursts free from the teleporter.
Endless streams of traffic, countless silhouettes of people... the bustle carries on as always.
"Sure looks lively, but..."

The screen before her lights up as people's joys and sorrows transform into specks of light, flowing into it.
"Even the NPCs' fatigue gauges are about to max out..."
"No way I'm playing a raid this boring."

Following the swipe of her finger, the city lights flicker on and off.
From an unnoticed corner comes a startled cry, followed by thunderous cheers echoing through the sky.
"All players' Luck doubled, randomized special talents, rewards maxed out..."
"Game loaded successfully! Time to run the show!"

The girl leaps down as familiar notification sounds ring in her ears.
Her game time has begun.

23058.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Elation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23058.lore:
A gentle breeze stirs the white curtains, tugging at the young girl's thoughts.
As she gazes at the chattering crowd outside her window, her drawing pen unconsciously pauses in place.
"How many times have I sat here now?"

In that fleeting moment, a falling petal brushes past her nose, as if in response, as if in reminder.
A grand game, a once-in-a-lifetime encounter, days and nights of blooming and withering flowers...
She recalls her story with this land, from a blank canvas to vibrant colors. With each slumber, she eagerly awaits tomorrow's arrival.

"Oh, the comic has been updated! I'll check it out after I finish drawing these cuties..."
The girl receives a notification, her ears perking up as her previously still pen springs back to life.

"I wish... by the next flower season, I'll catch up on all the top-rated new releases!"

23059.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23059.lore:
One moment, a rushing tide. The body sinks, plunging into the deepest reaches of the azure abyss.
One moment, a desolate isle. Echoes of the past resonate through the mist, drifting further and further away.
One moment, a field of crimson blooms of the farshore. Broken blades are scorched and reshaped in the raging inferno, finally becoming one.

"Since my time has not yet come, I shall forge myself anew."
With despair as the furnace and this body as the catalyst, he has lost count of how many times he has endured such agony.

"I shall take death as my hammer, and I will... sever this fate!!"
At the instant of rebirth, the flames scatter and surge toward the heavens, burning all the way to the edge of the farshore.
In that moment, all karmic debts are settled. The new body, tempered through a thousand trials, has finally been forged.

23060.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23060.lore:
Looking back at her childhood, she remembered the first time she heard adventure stories of the Trailblaze.
Her tiny heart beat for the mystery and vastness of the universe, so she picked up a paintbrush and drew her very first imaginings of the cosmos.
"A comet ship, a silver rail, a Navigator..."
"With this, is it possible to Trailblaze now?"

But a curse delayed her footsteps, and a sickbed confined her youth.
During those lonely times, towering stacks of books, scattered engine blueprints, and empty bottles of paint became her everyday life.
Her frail figure wielded the brush, carefully outlining the dream she yearned for.
"Perhaps I can seize more possibilities within this limited time."
"Even a dream is worth being illuminated by colors."

As the stars shifted once more, in the blink of an eye, she had already departed on her journey to the stars.
Carrying the wish she shared with her friend, she became the person she had always dreamed of becoming.

"The journey of the Trailblaze begins at this very moment."
The Express traverses the universe, and the footprints of the Navigator and her companions advancing side by side form a solid silver rail.
"Together, let's reach the future where the stars reside!"

23061.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23061.lore:
The instant magical energy surges forth, the gem's brilliant hues splash across the walls.
The teenage girl breaks into a delighted smile, carefully enfolding the dancing light with her palms.

"I did it! Does this mean I can also become a great mage someday?"
She envisions her future as a mage, planting the seed of a wish deep in her heart.

"You can do this, Rin Tohsaka! Succeeding once isn't enough! You need to succeed countless times!"
"I don't know what the future holds, but right now, just follow your heart and press forward!"
In this moment of triumph, her expectations of herself, her family's hopes, and the responsibility she shoulders all converge.
The girl quietly cheers herself on. She's ready to become the best version of herself.

The road ahead stretches long and arduous, yet her blazing heart shines brighter than any magic.

23062.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23062.lore:
Treasure, power, conquest, challenges... A jumble of fragments played on repeat in his mind.
In the flickering lamplight, the King drained his cup in one gulp.
"Overflowing riches, boundless lands, absolute power. All that is rightfully mine belongs to me."
"But if that is all there is... does anything truly matter?"

A languid figure sank into the plush sofa, thoughts and musings dissipating like smoke in an instant.
Even a king must occasionally surrender to his own desires and savor a moment of pleasure.
"What does it matter what I seek or gain? The moments when life pulses freely at my whim are the moments I treasure most."

23063.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23063.lore:
Seawater washes over her ankles, sea foam shattering beneath the moonlight. During a rare break from filming, the young girl accepted an invitation to the beach to attend a small campfire gathering.

The fire's light stretches out the children's shadows, their little faces painted with confusion. "I don't know how to sing," "I don't sing well," "I'm too scared to sing." The children look up at her as they ask timidly: "Miss Robin, what should we do?"
She smiles gently, her fingertips lightly touching the strings in lieu of an answer.

"Come, follow my lead."
The sea breeze seemed to drown out the first strum, but the second tune takes on a shape of its own. As the waves crash against the shore and the lights flicker, she parts her lips and sings softly, pouring out the clear, sunny sky from within her heart.
"When you don't know how to sing, just listen to the melody in your own hearts."
At first, the notes are scattered, but gradually an outline of a melody forms, and that outline is breathed into life. She sings, and they sing, until the summer breeze brushes past.
"Listen, this is the song in our hearts. It has always been there, waiting to be heard."

She hears it, and so, she gently offers this blessing:
"Rise and sing, then spread your wings and take flight."

23064.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Elation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
23064.lore:
Seawater washes over the board, the wave's crest tearing open a churning rift and shattering the sunlight into a million golden shards. He steps onto his surfboard, letting the roaring wave launch him into the air.

"High seas mean high risks, and high risks mean massive returns."
He challenges the waves time and time again, placing himself right at the eye of the storm. The height of summer, the blazing sun, the crisp sea breeze... The dizzying array of names, the fluctuating margins of profit and loss, the lies and schemes lurking in people's eyes... It all melts into blurry patches of color, no longer demanding his scrutiny.

"The tide has arrived. Now... just what will it leave in its wake?"
The ocean is boundless, much like the endless prosperity of Astropolis. Before tossing down his next chip, he rides the ridge of the wave and wagers his very being, fixing his gaze on that singular moment as he looks down upon the surging tide.

231.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 100 Relic EXP.
231.lore:
Lightdust permeated the Fragmentum, carrying what seems to indicate the existence of another civilization.

"Theosophy holds that the database used to store information of the material world is called the Akasha Records. I don't necessarily support this, but... these dust indeed store information from the past. They are like... seeds? When you water them, they can yield bountiful fruit."

232.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 500 Relic EXP.
232.lore:
Carefully collected Fragmentum dust with irregular shapes. Under the right conditions, they can express specific forms of relics.

When the stars return to the right position... Ha! Just kidding.

233.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 1000 Relic EXP.
233.lore:
A Fragmentum dust crystal that had densified after being reduced to its original form.

"This must not be placed together with the ores offered to the Amber Lord. This is a creation of the Stellaron and goes against the will of Preservation."

234.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 2000 Relic EXP.
234.lore:
A large Fragmentum dust crystal that had densified after being reduced to its original form.

"It can even recreate our deceased mother if it has enough information! It really can! Even if it was only for 26 seconds... I just have one question after I completed the experiment: Just why was the Fragmentum created?"

235.lore:
Broken parts of a relic that are one step away from decomposing into the Lightdust floating in the Fragmentum.

"Don't take them for mere scraps. I can restore them to their original state."

236.desc: A rare material used for customizing Relics. When synthesizing, you can designate 1 Main Stat from the possible options. With additional consumption, you can further designate 1 to 2 Subsidiary Stats.
236.lore:
This unknown resin is as smooth to the touch as finely-grained dust. It seems to be from the Fragmentum, and has been shaped into the form of a wish by an invisible hand.

"Based on the Guild's research, the Self-Modeling Resin may be the basis of the Fragmentum's capacity to replicate entities..."

237.desc: Matchless materials used to customize Relics. Can be used to specify up to 2 Subsidiary Stats when synthesizing.
237.lore:
An unknown resin that shines like crystals. It seems to have originated from within the Fragmentum. When you draw near, it will resonate strongly with the wishes within your heart.

"It tried to use the Fragmentum's duplicative ability to satisfy human desires, but alas, the gulf is insatiable."

238.desc: Use to re-assign the upgrade counts for Subsidiary Stats of fully-enhanced 5-star Relics and randomize their values.
238.lore:
A die formed from probability spins alone in the void. The bundled uncertainty ignites and goes out like the birth and death of stars. The universe is filled with variables. If even stars have a chance at resurrection, then what say a Relic?

"Attention: Hazardous variable. Be mindful when you roll the die. If you are not careful, a treasure could turn to trash."

239.desc: When using Variable Dice to reassign Subsidiary Stats of a 5-star Relic, you can select one Subsidiary Stat to block, preventing it from being enhanced during this reroll.
239.lore:
The integrated circuits within the encryption key are operating at full capacity, emitting interference factors that intercept countless light rays and correct their trajectories. In the information light screen occupying the entire sky dome, a small dark zone appears: a place even destiny must avoid.

"A discordant note emerges in the rapids of probability, refusing to go with the flow, driving itself like a nail into the marrow of destiny."

24.desc: Permanently increase max Technique Points by 1.
24.lore:
The Relic of a Nameless. An item that might have been a pocket watch or a compass.
It is said that the first part to break was the chain. It suddenly snapped during a warp jump, the links scattering everywhere.
Then, it was the back. Hit by a lead bullet, it was on the verge of falling apart.
Lastly, it was the markings on the face. They were gradually worn flat over the long years, becoming no longer visible.
It broke countless times and underwent endless repairs. Its former shape was no longer discernible, and only the stilled sharp hands were pointing ever forward.

Take it, Legwork. It's yours now... Then, continue onward...

24000.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Destruction. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
24000.lore:
It began with a flash of light.
One by one, THEY fell as the threat of expiration loomed over THEM.
THEY had to stop self-replicating and rushed to embrace each other,
trying to offer the right to reproduce in exchange for a possibility of survival.
THEY held hands in a show of unprecedented unity.
...But the Paths met an abrupt end,
and THEY were headed to a true death.

24001.desc: Light Cone for the Path of The Hunt. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
24001.lore:
Coursing 'tween the sea of stars,
THEY cruise with the speed of a rainbow's chromatic flash.
A journey of hunting undying abominations,
collecting cures and miracles,
and seeking deliverance.
Akin to a vow unbroken, THEIR voyage will be,
ad infinitum.

24002.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Preservation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
24002.lore:
The universe is like a wasteland filled with rubbish,
where occasional treasures lie undiscovered.
THEY sift through the cracks of yesterday, seeking seeds of memory.
...If a new life is to be born, its seed has to be dead.
Precious stones of pink, blue, and white are brought forth,
twinkling gently in THEIR seed plot,
even though the universe holds onto its enigmatic silence.

24003.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Nihility. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
24003.lore:
Things molded by the hands of secrecy are shapeless and incorporeal.
In the totality of emptiness, there yet exists a sudden dreaming.
Those that court destruction will reap ruinous fruit, while those that clamor to live will survive.
That which is extinguished may yet spark, and that which has dried may yet be filled anew.
In compassion for the salvation of chaos, the elixir nurtures the shadows.
With its back faced to the darkness between the stars, this vessel encapsulates futility and works in vain.

"Paradoxical these knowings are, in them shine the fullness of our pride."

24004.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Erudition. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
24004.lore:
Eternally suspended in the void,
Streams of shimmering data flood into THEIR mind.
Turning all things past and future into symbols,
THEY deduce the end from the beginning.
Knowledge, answers, truths...
In the mist of information, a brilliant light arises,
And everything becomes clear to THEM.

24005.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
24005.lore:
Be it bustling, desolate, fleeting, or enduring... every planet and every instant is brimming with countless events.
That condensed history melts at a single touch, flowing as tears from the world's gaze—

Some say: How heavy those tears must be, the amassed years capable of fading eternity.
Some say: How wondrous the stories they tell, sorrow so clear, joy so serene, unmarred by even a hint of falsehood.

The Cosmos flows in silent stillness, and THEY speak not, only watching—
Watching and waiting for them to become "memories."

24006.desc: Light Cone for the Path of Elation. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.
24006.lore:
Beneath the fingertips of geniuses, data flows steadily, endlessly.
Masks lurk in the cracks between "occurrences," observing every possibility waiting to unfold.

Analysis, extrapolation, answers, questions. Isn't this a perfect stage for geniuses?
Cheers, tears, roars, wails... the emotions of life bloom in full.

The silent play grows raucous, and blessings fill elation past the brim. Is this the most captivating act?
The answer remains the same: utterly unpredictable!

241.lore: Your victory is secured by countless failures, and the small steps you have taken led you to the turning point of fate.

25.desc: Traces from a past journey. Accumulate this to progress on the Path of Return.
25.lore: Tracks left behind by the Nameless. Follow its guidance to find your way back to Trailblaze's star rail.

250232.lore: A game item in Aetherium Wars. Aether Spirits will gain a special enhanced ability after equipping it.

250233.lore: A game item in Aetherium Wars. Aether Spirits will gain a special enhanced ability after equipping it.

250320.desc: A data chip used to increase Aether Spirit levels in the Aetherium Wars.
250320.lore: It was rumored that in the earliest version of Aetherium Wars, only the first Aether Spirit who battled can obtain experience, until the emergence of this chip which greatly reduced the grinding time needed for players.

250401.lore:
In the game Aetherium Wars, the proof of passing the Victory Zone test can be obtained by collecting four Mastery Marks, which qualifies you to participate in the championship. The Victory Zone of the Corridor of Fading Echoes grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contenders, Serval and Pela.

"You are a calm, yet passionate player!"

250402.lore:
In the game Aetherium Wars, the proof of passing the Victory Zone test can be obtained by collecting four Mastery Marks, which qualifies you to participate in the championship. The Victory Zone of Cloudford grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contender, Master Gongshu.

"You are a skilled and masterful player!"

250403.lore:
In the game Aetherium Wars, the proof of passing the Victory Zone test can be obtained by collecting four Mastery Marks, which qualifies you to participate in the championship. The Victory Zone of Herta Space Station grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contender, Herta.

"You are an intelligent player!"

250404.lore:
In the game Aetherium Wars, the proof of passing the Victory Zone test can be obtained by collecting four Mastery Marks, which qualifies you to participate in the championship. The Victory Zone of Great Mine grants you this proof, signifying your victory against the formidable championship contender, Giovanni.

"You are a player who knows how to enjoy!"

250601.desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the starting Cosmic Fragments in the Divergent Universe increases by 20.
250601.lore:
"The lost seeker found traces of truth in the mist. And so, he set off for the material world."

— Fables About the Stars by Adrian Spencer Smith

250602.desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Divergent Universe Curio store in Store Domains will increase the amount of purchasable Curios by 1.
250602.lore: The great Madam Herta. Even as her puppet, its every action is still suffused with the brilliance of intellect.

250603.desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Heat usable for Blessing Enhancement increases by 1 point in the Divergent Universe First Plane's Workbench of Creation.
250603.lore: The infinite layers of nutshells encase the ruler of the infinite universe, yet even so, she continues to turn the key, opening the next door infinitely.

250604.desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the amount of Cosmic Fragments needed to overwrite Equations in the Divergent Universe's Workbench of Creation decreases by 10.
250604.lore:
So you're saying that Professor Ratio, whose pass rate is like the gacha rates in the Interastral Peace Entertainment's blind boxes, actually passed you? Stop pulling my leg.
...
What, are you serious?

250605.desc: After this item is placed in the Probability Museum, your team will recover 2 Technique Points after entering a Boss Domain in Divergent Universe.
250605.lore:
"What are you carving on the tombstone, one-eyed poet?"
"Proof of our existence."

250606.desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, receive 1 attempt to reset Blessings for free in the Divergent Universe Third Plane's Workbench of Creation.
250606.lore: Hey, don't rub my tail when I'm asleep!

250607.desc: After this item is placed in the Probability Museum, restores HP equal to 20% of Max HP for all allies when entering a domain in Divergent Universe.
250607.lore: The sheath of Excalibur faintly visible within the illusion, is like the continuation of a dream.

250608.desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Cosmic Fragments obtained after a battle victory in the Divergent Universe increases by 1.
250608.lore: A crystal relief modeled after Command Spells, engraved with the hero's past.

250609.desc: After displaying this in the Probability Museum, the Divergent Universe Blessing store in "Store" Domains will increase the amount of purchasable Blessings by 1.
250609.lore: Intellitron bodies are built for freedom. In theory, Pearl really could upload her consciousness into this model... if the network wasn't blocked.

250610.desc: Increases Elation of characters in the Divergent Universe by 3%.
250610.lore: When you don't think it's funny, just give us a smile. A smile is the gentlest invention in the world, and it never needs a reason.

250700.desc: When an ally uses their Ultimate, their action is immediately Advanced Forward, and Weakness Break Efficiency increases.
250700.lore:
One of the tactics summarized from actual combat.

"By attracting the opponent's attention with feints, the true move remains undetected."

250701.desc: Allies gain Early Reveal. In the effect duration, after every attack, launch 1 attack against all enemies that have been hit and inflict them with the debuff.
250701.lore:
A tactic learned from real combat.

"Any minute movement in the arena will be infinitely magnified. Use this trait to make your opponents excessively alert and on the defense."

250702.desc: Applies Burn, Shock, Bleed, and Wind Shear on all enemies, and causes all enemies to immediately take action, triggering the DoT effects.
250702.lore:
One of the tactics summarized from actual combat.

"Avoid the opponent's peak performance period, and strike with a decisive blow when they are exhausted."

250703.desc: All allies immediately activate their Ultimates.
250703.lore:
One of the tactics summarized from actual combat.

"Transform feints into real moves, turn illusions into reality, and exploit the opponent's misjudgment of the situation to solidify one's own advantage."

250704.desc: Causes allied character to immediately take another action after their next action and increases their DMG dealt.
250704.lore:
A tactic learned from real combat.

"You must keep pushing your enemy when you're at an advantage and smash their hopes of turning the table."

250705.desc: All allies immediately take action, recover Skill Points, and increases Weakness Break Efficiency.
250705.lore:
One of the tactics summarized from actual combat.

"Seize every opportunity, turn defense into offense, establish an advantage, and secure victory in the end."

250706.desc: For every target on the field, increases DMG by allies.
250706.lore:
A tactical beverage brand favored by many professional fighters.

"One bottle of Pulse Energy, and you'll instantly gain energy enough for a pulsar explosion."

250707.desc: After using Ultimate to deal DMG, increases Ultimate DMG dealt to the target of the attack.
250707.lore:
A tactical beverage brand that often sponsors extreme sports.

"Under Blu Bull's dome, go big or go home!"

250708.desc: For each DoT status the enemy target is afflicted with, increases the DMG taken by them.
250708.lore:
A tactical beverage brand known to the public for its product placement in a popular immersia.

"Devil's Hand, awaken the devilish power within you."

250709.desc: For each target an ally defeats, regenerates a small amount of Energy.
250709.lore:
A tactical beverage brand named after the roc of the west from Xianzhou folklore.

"Tired? Sleepy? Fret not, have a Westroc Super Drink."

250710.desc: After triggering Follow-Up ATK, increases DMG received by target.
250710.lore:
A tactical beverage brand said to cause the illusion of increased strength.

"Drink Mighty Quench, might bring miracles."

250711.desc: Increases Break Effect. There is a chance of recovering Skill Points when dealing Break DMG.
250711.lore:
The Family has released a customized SoulGlad for the Wardance Ceremony.

"Have a SoulGlad, be so glad and win."

251.lore:
Sighing embers formed when a shooting star fell from the sky.

"At least they were once hot and bright."

251001.desc: Tuskpirs originate in the Xianzhou Zhuming. It is a wondrous creature that feeds upon human dreams and is often used to treat psychological ailments involving anxiety and unease.
251001.lore: "Tuskpirs are so cute. How could anyone just eat them..."

251002.desc: How do you raise a little chimera? Add a bit of liveliness, a dash of competitive spirit, and a love for water... Uh-oh, too much of everything!
251002.lore: "Bubbles' top three priorities: First place, first place, and winning first place!"

251003.desc: A registered little chimera at the Garden of Life who prefers sharing opinions about everything around them rather than focusing on actual work.

251004.desc: The Furbobo Press Corps, led by Furbulitzer, your most trusted, most talkative, and most work-life-balanced employees.
251004.lore: "Don't rush, everyone! One at a time!"

251005.desc: A common imagenae of Planarcadia, this creature experienced an unexpected awakening in an accident that gifted it with far richer emotions than other emotis. With up to five distinct expressions at its disposal, it has developed a unique curiosity and perspective on the World of Elation.

251520.lore: Rules are made to be followed, meow!"
