252.lore:
Splendid gems formed when a shooting star fell from the sky.

"Precious things stay precious."

252000.desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
252000.lore: An exquisite uniform that Pom-Pom wears while welcoming or bidding farewell to guests. It sports carmine velvet with metallic accessories, displaying the conductor's extraordinary bearing. The pocket watch that is cleaned ten times a day is the key to the Express' stable passage.

252001.desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
252001.lore: A chef's outfit Pom-Pom wears when they are in charge of cooking. It has experienced the clashing of kitchen utensils and also the crackling symphony of frying and cooking, yet remains white and pure, unblemished by grease. Pom-Pom has never revealed the secret to how they achieved this.

252002.desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
252002.lore: Pom-Pom's pajamas, which they wear to bed at home, are not usually shown to others... unless they're too sleepy to notice. The light blue base color resembles the morning sky. Some passengers think the white fluffy ball on the hat tip is imitating the Pepeshi people, but that's just a baseless rumor.

252003.desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
252003.lore: A vintage formal outfit Pom-Pom wears for role-playing sessions. Despite Pom-Pom's best efforts to add some gravitas with a fake beard, not a single passenger recognized the tribute to a certain Nameless: the conductor is just too adorable!

252004.desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
252004.lore: The finest attire Pom-Pom wears on formal occasions. Forged from the galaxy's most advanced craftsmanship, every stitch and thread radiates dazzling, opulent gold, clearly reserved for only the grandest of celebrations.

252106.desc: A special item used in Guest Occurrences. Can be used to reroll the random wheel once.
252106.lore:
The desire of "not wanting to have regrets" materialized into a miraculous coin.

"The decision you wanted to make via tossing a coin was already decided long before the coin fell."

252125.desc:
Used to request Assistants and collect Memory Cards.
Can be obtained by completing Exhibition missions, Exhibition Occurrences, Exhibition achievements, leveling up Assistants, and more.
252125.lore: The most common premium currency found in gaming products by the Interastral Peace Entertainment. It is the sole currency for many powerful items, thus earning much ire from the players.

252126.desc:
Used to unlock research content.
Can be obtained by increasing venue levels, completing exhibition missions, etc.
252126.lore: A fleeting spark of inspiration is also fuel for reshaping reality.

252127.desc:
The most basic resource for unlocking booths and increasing assistant levels.
Accumulate enough Gold Coins to increase Venue Level.

Gold Coin units from smallest to largest: K (thousand), M (million), B (billion), T (trillion), followed by AA, BB, CC... and so on.
Each adjacent unit is 1000 times larger than the previous.
252127.lore: The most common non-premium currency in the game, said to be made of real gold. Its value is less stable than credits but still makes for an excellent keepsake.

252128.desc:
Used for Standard Invitations.
Can be obtained by completing missions, Exhibition Occurrences, increasing the Venue Level, and more.
252128.lore: A plain admission ticket, suitable as a gift to close friends. As the old saying on Xianzhou goes, "A small gift bears one's vast appreciation."

252129.desc:
Used for Golden Invitations.
Can be obtained through missions, Exhibition Occurrences, increasing the Venue Level, and more.
252129.lore: An admission ticket adorned with gold foil, exuding formality. Even friends who initially declined the invitation may be swayed by its elegance.

252130.desc:
Used for Resplendent Invitation.
Can be obtained through missions, Exhibition Occurrences, increasing the Venue Level, and more.
252130.lore: A trendy admission ticket with a dazzling holographic finish. Even the most distinguished guests will find it hard to refuse as a gift — After all, they came for you.

252131.desc:
Used to pull Memory Cards.
Can be obtained by increasing venue levels and completing exhibition events and missions.
252131.lore: A toy, a room, a photograph... Everyone has something that stirs memories. This item is their physical manifestation.

252301.lore: The trailblazing memories deep in your mind will provide inspiration to the game once you recall it in full.

253000.desc: As you traverse a distant path and look back on the silver rails, the origin of the journey continues to shine radiantly. Look, that was your first decision.

253001.desc: Every single star has its own story amidst the boundless starry seas. The Trailblaze never ends — venture into the unknown and explore even more wondrous worlds!

253002.desc: The giant bears the weight of heaven in silence, earning worship and reverence from all. Without it, everything would inevitably crumble.
253002.lore: "I'll leave the rest to you, partner!"

253003.desc: Just a Phantasmoon blowing a party blower.
253003.lore: "In the past, whenever it struck this pose, it would spit watermelon seeds like a machine gun."

253004.desc: A top player zips through a miniature city, determined to leave not a single Gold Coin behind. What do you think? Can she make it all the way to the end?
253004.lore: "Why guess? This one plays itself. Got anything tougher?"

253005.desc: The coolest patterns are already emblazoned on the car. Time to break free and soar across the horizon!

254000.desc: Every footprint left in the sea of stars is a proof of the heart's desire.

254001.desc: In the endless river of time, each drop of joy is worthy of a place in the pockets of memory, to be treasured eternally and savored time and time again.

260000.desc: The currency used in Membrance Maze, modeled after fairy-like creatures. Earned through restaurant operations, it can be used for various expenses during business management.
260000.lore: "—Rule number one of the Maze civilization: Don't forget to pay for your food."

260013.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260013.lore: The most common crop in the Membrance Maze. The scholar who took over the farmland has repeatedly emphasized to the fairies that, biologically speaking, it's actually a type of celtuce.

260014.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260014.lore: A juicy fruit with a sweet and sour taste. Fairies once had endless debates about whether it should be classified as a fruit or a vegetable.

260015.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260015.lore: Plant the golden seeds and harvest an ocean of gold. The windmill spins round and round, grinding the seeds into powder, baking them into golden cookies and bread.

260016.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260016.lore: It's said to protect your eyes and prevent night blindness. That's why it's unexpectedly popular in the dimly lit Membrance Maze.

260017.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260017.lore: Cutting it stings your eyes and makes them all red. The fairy who first discovered this phenomenon revealed this secret with tears in their eyes.

260018.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260018.lore: A versatile ingredient that's delicious whether steamed, boiled, grilled, stir-fried, deep-fried, braised, or stewed. Best not to eat after it sprouts.

260019.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260019.lore: Named after a fairy's accidental discovery: when placed in a furnace, it makes a "pop-pop" crackling sound.

260020.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260020.lore: Crispy and sweet in taste, simple to prepare. It's a popular side dish among fairies who aren't too keen on cooking.

260021.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260021.lore: In the Membrance Maze, pumpkins symbolize "harvest." For fairies, they're enormous creatures. Their hard yet sweet flesh can provide sustenance for a long time. Plus, when roasted, the seeds make for a delicious snack.

260022.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260022.lore: "When you eat the Quillorb, the Quillorb eats you back." None of the fairies understood what the scholar who took over the farmland meant when he said this with an emotionless face.

260023.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260023.lore: Sweet peas neatly arranged in their pods. The secret to opening the pods is to first tear off the fibrous string on the side. Such delicate work poses quite a challenge for fairy claws.

260024.desc: Normal Ingredients — Fruits and vegetables that can be used for cooking dishes
260024.lore: Named after the "Hiss-Ha Hiss-Ha" sounds made by fairies who tasted it. After years of mutual adaptation, fairies finally stopped eating the Hissa Peppers whole and instead began chopping them up to use as seasoning.

260031.desc: Rare Ingredients — Seasonings used for cooking dishes
260031.lore: According to fairy folklore, it flows on the tree trunks deep in the forest, as yellow as gold and as transparent as amber. It's reverently known as "Hachimead."

260032.desc: Rare Ingredients — Seasonings used for cooking dishes
260032.lore: The sour juice is commonly used as a seasoning to enhance flavor. When fairies quarrel, they sometimes accuse each other of being "as sharp-tongued as a sour fruit."

260033.desc: Rare Ingredients — Meat ingredients that can be used for cooking dishes
260033.lore: Where did that money-grubbing merchant get the meat from? I guess that's just another secret left behind by this dreamlike, mysterious land.

260034.desc: Rare Ingredients — Seasonings used for cooking dishes
260034.lore: A soft and sweet dairy delight. The delicate aroma melts exquisitely on the tongue, creating an enchanting sensation.

260035.desc: Special ingredients for leveling up dishes
260035.lore: A mysterious crystal extracted from crops, possessing magical energy that imbues dishes with deliciousness. Due to its scarce yield, it's extremely precious and is considered as a gift from the Maze.

261.desc: Used to exchange for rewards at the Light Cone Manifest shop.
261.lore:
An afterimage of bygone days, invaluable to the Garden of Recollection.

The Garden of Recollection has its own rules: Exchange time for time and memory for memory. The Garden of Recollection can even bring back to you a lost, irrevocable past for the right cost...

261001.desc: Can be used to enhance combat items in Origami Bird Clash
261001.lore:
A toolbox that even an Origami Bird can use — Full of tools! Easy to use! Anyone with hands will be able to make use of it!

"But Origami Birds don't have hands, tweet...?"

262.desc: Used to exchange for rewards at the Jokes Come True shop.
262.lore:
In 2104 AE, Fomenko — a Candelagraphos scribe — obtained a mute parrot. She took great care of it, but it still only lived for less than a decade. To commemorate her mute friend, Fomenko made quills out of the ten outermost feathers of the parrot's wings. One of these was for herself, while the other nine were stored in a vault.
She used this one quill to annotate for an entire Amber Era, preserving vast swathes of ancient documents on the verge of being lost. At her funeral, her peers and students burst into tears because "a lamp that illuminated our cosmic past had been snuffed out."
It wasn't until people went over Fomenko's legacy that they finally realized that the scribe had been writing nothing but lies with her quills.

"Since the beginning of human history, the birds have been observing all the glory, folly, and glorious and foolish things humans have accomplished. The birds know. The birds take part. The birds remain silent."

262000.desc: Dye for {TEXTJOIN#247}. New look, new mood.
262000.lore: A color that gives off the tranquil vibes of the ocean! According to {TEXTJOIN#247}, this shade seems to be trending among the dromas.

262001.desc: Dye for {TEXTJOIN#247}. New look, new mood.
262001.lore: A color that better matches Earth's impression! {TEXTJOIN#247} says this color makes it feel very resilient.

262002.desc: Dye for {TEXTJOIN#247}. New look, new mood.
262002.lore: "Actually, there's no purple dye. It's just washing off the other dyes with water," {TEXTJOIN#247} explained.

262003.desc: Dye for {TEXTJOIN#247}. New look, new mood.
262003.lore: The color of a flawless sky! {TEXTJOIN#247} said this color made it feel full of wisdom.

262004.lore: Handmade by the good friend Little Chimera~ As for how exactly it was made, that remains a mystery.

262005.lore: Seems like it's a welcome gift from the Grove of Epiphany. No one ever thought of putting it on a dromas before, but it fits surprisingly well!

262006.lore: A safety helmet made by Mountain Dweller craftsmen, specially customized into an adorable design for {TEXTJOIN#247}.

262007.lore: "A symbol of a warrior for the rising star of Okhema, dromas {TEXTJOIN#247}."

262008.lore: "Ding-a-ling, grow up quick!" — A parent's wish

262009.lore: "Keep your thoughts rational, and be resplendent and resilient like a crystal." — Professor

262010.lore: "May your wings grow strong. May you soar across the azure blue sky" — Doctor

262011.lore: "Try listen to it. You can hear the distant horizon." — Warrior

262012.lore: Made with comfortable fabric that is warm and breathable. Simple in design, practical in use.

262013.desc: One of {TEXTJOIN#247}'s outfits, in the Okhema style.
262013.lore: The pursuit of fashion is a universal instinct among all species. This piece looks exceptionally elegant!

262014.lore: "Shh, it's praying! What a spiritual little fellow."

262015.lore: Once you put it on, the usual grumph sound seems to gain power and doubles as an insomnia cure.

263.desc: Rewards can be redeemed at the Gift of Stardust Store
263.lore:
The peculiar planet of Convergence-λ possesses an elusive orbit, and its residents occasionally stare into the void, performing acts without logic. The IPC sent people to investigate, but their efforts were always met with one absurd reply: "Because I did it." The Intelligentsia Guild finally detected the influence of the Path of Equilibrium within the world's Crystallite, leading them to pose the crucial question:
"Where is your 'I'?"
"Here, and there."
They gestured to themselves, and to the nonexistent barycenter beyond their world, reaching out into the distant void...
"...They could never walk into the annihilating embrace of a binary star system, for they were never truly able to hold one another."

264996.desc: Exchange tokens used in the Cosmicon Collective Store, each one a testament to your honor in battle.

264997.desc: Special exchange tokens used in the Cosmicon Collective Store, issued during events to redeem content from Expansion Pack I.

264998.desc: The crystalline dust that drifts out after Cosmicon Collective duel. It is said to be the mark left by the dicerollers' conflicting wills. Collect a certain amount to give the cards you own a new glow.

264999.desc: Use it to increase Experience Level of Cosmicon Collective. It represents a diceroller's combat Experience. The higher the Experience, the easier it is to earn respect from others, which is how the bracelet is passed down, after all.

266001.desc: A special token for this livestream that can be used to upgrade in-game character slots.

266002.desc: A special token for this livestream that can be used to unlock in-game Talent Nodes.

266003.desc: A special item for this livestream that can be used to obtain a great number of in-game equipment.

266005.desc: A special token for this livestream that can be used to pull new in-game characters.

268201.desc: The casing design is a tribute to the original Pixel Plane game cartridge. Now, as a reward for the top contenders in "Pixel Plane Rumble," it can be used to unlock new pixel plane models.
268201.lore: "A yellowed casing, housing a lifetime of unfading joy."

269001.desc: Special exchange tokens used in the Cosmicon Collective Store, issued during events to redeem content from Expansion Pack II.
269001.lore: That pattern up there... No matter how you look at it, it's that furbo who calls itself the "boss's right-hand man"!

270000.desc: A digital smile that can be used to purchase items in the Deep Web Gray Market.
270000.lore: Countless graffiti flourish on the streets of Punklorde, and this plain smiley face is one of the favorite signatures of internet dwellers. Once, when the hacker known as Zero paralyzed the entire planet's network, this smile of freedom was everywhere in Rainbow City.

270001.lore:
A certification of Aurum Alley's economic prosperity. It can be used to obtain benefits from the Merchant Guild.

"May Aurum Alley rise once more!""Agh. Every time the president says that, it means we've got some unpaid overtime coming our way..."

270002.desc: Points gifted by viewers in Ghostly Grove. They can be used to redeem rewards from the subscription plan.
270002.lore: "How would you evaluate the commercialization of Ghostly Grove?" "Please don't worry, Ghostly Grove may disappear in the future, but it will never lose its essence."

270003.desc: A commemorative badge from the band's performance, proving your contribution to the success of the music party. It can be used to claim rewards from performance remunerations.

270004.desc: A melody often played at Phagousa's banquets, now resounding once more with your victory. Can be used at the Prize Exchange to increase the Carnival Level and claim rewards.

270005.desc: Handcrafted "Seal Tokens" by Apophis, each bearing a unique mark. Can be used to purchase baby seals at the Baby Seal Shop.
270005.lore: "Made by Apophis, issued by Apophis, redeemed by Apophis, collected by Apophis."

270006.desc: A crystalline speck formed from traces of Wishpower, the ultimate nutrient for wispae.

271.desc: A special gadget made by Herta. It can Superimpose special Light Cones obtained from the Simulated Universe.
271.lore:
A special gadget made by Herta. Its principles are not stated.

"Be grateful, {NICKNAME}. I've prepared everything for you."

281.desc: Used to exchange for a 5-star character at the Stellar Convergence shop.
281.lore: "Even the tiniest speck of dust, drawn by the call of exploration, can gather into a dazzling golden nova."

281001.lore:
The funds managed by the Aurum Alley Merchant's Guild. Primarily used toward business activities and infrastructural maintenance.

"Don't ask why we don't use straight cash. There's a dark history there."

281003.lore:
"The great life-nurturing potion is actually... strawberry-flavored?"
"I don't believe it unless you let me taste it."

281005.desc: The tips given by the monsters who patronize the Dreamjolt Hostelry. Can be used to redeem rewards in the Revenue Statistics.
281005.lore:
It's actually the caps of SoulGlad soda bottles.

"Even seemingly useless items are the most precious treasures to some."

281013.desc: An indescribable material. Used to unlock abilities in the Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.
281013.lore:
A number that you can accumulate and consume to increase the strength of the Support system inside Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.

"An impulse arising from organic life, requiring some effort to capture inside the nervous system... And in the deduction, it becomes a, uh, a number?"

281014.desc: A basic item for moving forward on the Cosmodyssey map.
281014.lore:
The most commonly used dice in Cosmodyssey.

"Pom-Pom's design cannot be printed on it. It's called a Pom-Pom Dice. What if there's a bandit printed on it?"

281015.desc: A mysterious game token materialized from the trailblazing experience. Contribute to Pom-Pom to convert them to Trailblaze blessings.
281015.lore:
The game currency widely used in Cosmodyssey.

"Acquiring 'Trailblazing Experience' is a bit abstract. But if I call it 'making a lot of money,' will it be easier to understand?"

281016.desc: Item used for moving forward on the Cosmodyssey map. You can select which Dice Face you want.
281016.lore:
A die used for cheating in Cosmodyssey.

"When you have a chance to make a choice, make one that you know you won't regret."

281017.desc: A special item used to backtrack in Board Encounters. It allows you to re-roll the die again.
281017.lore:
The wish of "having no regrets" materialized into a mysterious coin.

"The decision you want to make via tossing a coin was already decided long before the coin fell."

281018.desc: Indescribable materials used to unlock abilities in the Divergent Universe.
281018.lore:
A numerical value that you can accumulate and consume to enhance the strength of the support system in the Divergent Universe.

"Turning a fleeting cluster of electrons in the circuit into a quantifiable value... It's a pity, I had hoped it would take the form of a butterfly."

281019.desc: The hard-earned personal savings of the Galactic Baseballer. Can be used to purchase baseballs in the Cosmic Store.

281020.desc: Indescribable materials used to unlock the ability system in Protean Hero.
281020.lore: Pilgrim, please snap off the Sacred Tree's branch with reverence. In return, the god shall bestow upon you words of wisdom and guidance.

281022.desc: Important research results. Used to increase the Synchronicity Level in the Divergent Universe.
281022.lore:
Sample data from the test. You can accumulate it to increase the Synchronicity Level in the Divergent Universe.

"Record: Significant improvement observed in the synchronicity fit of the target being tracked for the experiment. Variable corrections completed. Initiating Equation construction module."

281025.desc: Commemorative badge awarded to the winner of the Wardance. Can be used to redeem Wardance Plaudits.
281025.lore:
A bronze sword-shaped badge.

"The sword-shaped token symbolizes the martial virtue of the Xianzhou people."

281026.desc: A value you can accumulate or spend to strengthen Support systems in the Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain.
281026.lore: "The 'Scepters,' which should be closed off to organic life, didn't reject questions but actually collected all the scholars' hypotheses. Screwllum, do you think they might be... learning?"

281027.desc: A currency common across the cosmos. Can be used to purchase items in the Cosmic Store.

281028.desc: Reputation gained by the Galactic Baseballer in their adventure. This can be used to claim rewards provided by the Planetary Safety Committee.

281030.desc: A unique game cartridge used to unlock items and enhancements in "Arcadian Chronicles"
281030.lore: "No need for a fancy name. Let's just call it 'Cartridge.' It's just a game. We can make one of those, too."

281031.desc: The core economic resource in Currency Wars gameplay, used for purchasing squad members, increasing Experience, and refreshing the Store.
281031.lore: Throughout civilizations, there's an ancient tradition of minting gold into round coins. Even in today's era of digital currencies, a hefty gold coin still gives people a solid sense of security.

281032.desc: Obtained through Currency Wars gameplay, can be used to activate "Advantage Layout."
281032.lore: I wonder which genius came up with the idea of combining diamonds and banknotes. Carbon and paper, the most ordinary materials in the universe, somehow managed to become such valuable equivalents.

281033.desc: Obtained through Currency Wars gameplay, can be used to increase your "Ascension Level."
281033.lore: For any IPC Worker, there is no need to explain the significance of ascending the corporate ladder. On this path to the pinnacle of power, every step forward comes with an enormous cost.

281034.desc: Experience material used to increase the team's size in Currency Wars. Automatically gains 2 points after clearing each Node. Can also be purchased with Gold Coins

281035.desc: A resource used to refresh the Store in Currency Wars. When this resource is available, refreshing the Store will not consume Gold Coins.

281036.desc: Gold Coins commonly found throughout Planarcadia and Astropolis. They can be exchanged for items, but there is a weekly cap on how many you can obtain.
281036.lore:
A currency formed from accumulated fragments of Wishpower, symbolizing intelligent life's stereotypical view of "wealth."
According to the Vehicle City Accord ratified in Arcadian Calendar Year 1985, universal equivalents pegged to Wishpower can also circulate in Astropolis.

"The best currency investment these days: earn Arcadia Coins, spend credits!"

281037.desc: A special invitation ticket for the "Chimera World Tournament" that unlocks chimera trainers you want to fight alongside with in the selection interface. It can be earned by participating in the tournament.

281038.desc: A special snack beloved by all creations. Can be used to cheer for creations in the "Snack Dash" event and exchange for rewards.

281040.desc: The universal currency of the Interastral Peace Corporation's Postmortem Employment Center, reserved exclusively for ghost employees who truly love the IPC even in death.
281040.lore: "Work hard! The IPC will treat us right!"

282.desc: Used to exchange for Golden Companion Spirits at the Stellar Convergence shop.
282.lore: "Even the tiniest speck of dust, drawn by the call of exploration, can gather into a dazzling silver nova."

283.desc: Used to exchange for a 5-star Light Cone at the Stellar Convergence shop.
283.lore: "Perhaps I'll be able to piece together the fragmented memories once I catch up to that light."

284.desc: Obtained through Astral Imagea reclamation. Collect a certain amount to exchange for Trendible Vouchers at the Cosmetics Store.
284.lore: The IPC's latest research findings, cleverly woven into the creation of collectible figures, mystery boxes, and other products, giving each toy a delightful personality of its own. The results speak for themselves as every new release flies off the shelves.

291.lore:
In Planarcadia, where wishes can become strength, your desire to "hold the light high and become a hero" has answered your call, taking physical form to inspire your journey onward. Accept it for now, sooner or later, it will become your one-of-a-kind help.

"According to highly unreliable statistics, everyone in Planarcadia has dreamed of transforming into a superhero at some point."

3.lore: Crystallized lights floating in the sea of stars, pulsing with the residual dream of an ancient leviathan. Everything of the old world turned in the end into candlelight that illuminates the darkness ahead.

300002.desc: Gifts between Pathstriders. Select one material of your choice.
300002.lore: Your companions would eventually reach their own ends. Hopefully, this gift can accompany you on an even longer journey.

300003.desc: Gifts between Pathstriders. Select one rare material of your choice.
300003.lore: Your companions would eventually reach their own ends. Hopefully, this gift can accompany you on an even longer journey.

300011.desc: A treasure left by the Nameless. Select one Light Cone of your choice.
300011.lore: Treasure hidden amongst the starry seas by the bygone Nameless. These items encourage future explorers to step onward bravely and ceaselessly.

300012.desc: A treasure left by the Nameless. Select one Light Cone of your choice.
300012.lore: Treasure hidden amongst the starry seas by the bygone Nameless. These items encourage future explorers to step onward bravely and ceaselessly.

300013.desc: A precious treasure drifting in the endless sea of stars. Select one Light Cone of your choice.
300013.lore: The memories of countless lives are stored in Light Cones, awaiting a Nameless to unseal them.

300014.desc: A precious treasure drifting in the endless sea of stars. Select one Light Cone of your choice.

300018.desc:
The container used by the Garden of Recollection to store Light Cones. You can choose to obtain one of the following 4-star Light Cones after opening it:
"Quid Pro Quo," "Fermata," "We Are Wildfire," "River Flows in Spring," "Past and Future," "Woof! Walk Time!," "The Seriousness of Breakfast," "Victory In a Blink," "Mushy Shroomy's Adventures"
300018.lore: This casket stores rare memories plucked by the Memokeepers. Crystallized slices of time will emerge when the casket cracks open.

300019.lore: This casket stores rare memories plucked by the Memokeepers. Crystallized slices of time will emerge when the casket cracks open.

300021.desc: A carefully prepared present from a certain Masked Fool.
300021.lore: "Sparkle will never give you up, never let you down, or run around and desert you. She will never make you cry, say goodbye, or tell a lie and hurt you."

300031.desc: A fine-looking envelope containing a custom-made ticket.

300041.desc:
The assistance provided by Herta to the Astral Express. Upon use, you can select one item to obtain from the following materials:
· Lifeless Blade
· Arrow of the Demon Slayer
· Key of Knowledge
· Oath of Steel
· Obsidian of Desolation
· Ancestral Hymn
· Sprout of Life
300041.lore:
Materials provided to the Express in accordance with the mutual aid contract.

"Since it's mutual aid, save your thanks."

300042.desc:
The assistance provided by Herta to the Astral Express. Upon use, you can select one item to obtain from the following materials:
· Worldbreaker Blade
· Arrow of the Starchaser
· Key of Wisdom
· Safeguard of Amber
· Obsidian of Obsession
· Stellaris Symphony
· Flower of Eternity
300042.lore:
Materials provided to the Express in accordance with the mutual aid contract.

"Since it's mutual aid, save your thanks."

300051.desc: Unclaimed parcel. Opening them may yield random materials.
300051.lore:
Due to various reasons, the recipient did not receive this parcel, and the sender did not retrieve it either. When selling these parcels, the Sky-Faring Commission scans them in advance to ensure that there are no dangerous goods (or excessively valuable items) inside.

"Mystery boxes like this are scams. Last time, I opened five boxes with expired mung bean sodas in a row..."
"How did this not get flagged as a dangerous item during the screening process!"

300052.desc: Unclaimed valuable parcel. Opening them may yield random rare materials.
300052.lore:
Due to various reasons, the recipient did not receive this parcel, and the sender did not retrieve it either. When selling these parcels, they are scanned by the Sky-Faring Commission in advance to ensure that there are no dangerous goods, and the more valuable items inside are individually priced as well.

"Do you think we can get Light Cones in these?"
"Dream on, maybe after you managed to pull a wife out from one first."

300054.lore:
You have so much morals to the point that the High Morals condensed into a greater physical existence and arrived at your side.

"{NICKNAME}, you are a paragon!"

300055.desc: The Cosmos is full of peculiarities. This box contains specialties from various planets. Open it. You might find something you need inside.

300056.desc: Yao Guang's Fortune Pouch — May good fortune be with you always, come back soon!
300056.lore: "This place, this moment, this thing, this act... such good fortune could only belong to {NICKNAME}!"

300058.desc:
A letter dispatched from a distant place, carrying within it a thin, warmly printed picture book of dreams.

The road was long and winding, yet someone carefully preserved the crayon drawings, tying up the strings and smoothing the creased corners... until they finally reach your hands, where the dreams sealed within the letter remain as fresh as ever.
300058.lore:
"Only the hopes and aspirations of children must never be failed."

"Now, it falls to you to guard their dreams. The Interstellar, set sail!"

300101.lore:
Provisions prepared by the Express for Trailblazers. Claim with pass.

"Dear conductor, can we not punch holes in the cards? I want to collect a whole collection of them."

300102.desc: An unopened treasure. Use to gain the effect equivalent to purchasing Nameless Glory once.

300103.desc: An unopened treasure. Use to gain the effect equivalent to purchasing Nameless Medal once.

300104.desc: An unopened treasure. Use it to upgrade the Nameless Glory to the Nameless Medal.

300200.desc: The on-sale collectors' edition containing the entirety of The Adventurous Moles: Hidden Treasure.
300200.lore: A children's adventure book very popular in Belobog.

300202.desc: This currency, used by the Interastral Peace Corporation to settle accounts with its customers, is now widely accepted as the hard currency for space travel... Right?
300202.lore: "People run around fighting and trading for numbers in a terminal, but the truly precious cannot be bought."

300210.lore:
A tome containing prophecies. Upon closer inspection, one will discover that the scroll is woven from golden threads.

"There is a prophecy within that will only be revealed to the one who opens the scroll."

300211.lore:

309012.lore: The memories of countless lives are stored in Light Cones, awaiting a Nameless to unseal them.

31.desc: A unique currency obtained through exploring Simulated Universe. Will be cleared after Simulated Universe is restarted.
31.lore:
File fragments generated when the Simulated Universe is running. When they pile up, the performance of Simulated Universe will be significantly affected.

"Sort them regularly. In return, the admin can perhaps change your stats every now and then."

310014.desc: Obtain the Trailblaze Fashion "Cool Overload Shades" and Name Card "Arcadia Rush"
310014.lore: "Ding — exclusive hacker look installed. Cosmic Speedrun initialized. Ready when you are."

311000.desc: The Herta and the Express have achieved a strategic agreement. She has increased her support for the Express to better uncover precious things found during trailblazing expedition.

311001.desc: The Herta and the Express have achieved a strategic agreement. She has increased her support for the Express to better uncover precious things found during trailblazing expedition.
